englishExplanation: In acquired HUS, the coagulation pathway should not be affected. Normal coagulation studies distinguish HUS from DIC (which has abnormal PT/PTT/fibrinogen).
arabicExplanation: في HUS المكتسب: فحوصات التخثر طبيعية (normal coagulation studies). هذا ما يميز HUS عن DIC حيث PT/PTT غير طبيعية.

question: What is the best approach to managing a pediatric patient with Escherichia coli-induced hemolytic uremic syndrome?

options.text: Antibiotics to treat E. coli infection

englishExplanation: HUS treatment is primarily supportive including fluids. Avoid antibiotics (risk of increased HUS) and antiperistaltic agents. Transfuse if Hgb <7 g/dL. Platelets only if <10K and bleeding.
arabicExplanation: علاج HUS داعم بشكل أساسي: سوائل. تجنب المضادات الحيوية ومضادات الحركة المعوية. نقل الدم إذا Hgb <7. الصفيحات فقط إذا <10K مع نزف.

question: Which medication is associated with an elevated risk of ureteral calculi?
englishExplanation: Indinavir (HIV protease inhibitor) crystallizes in urine causing ureteral stones. ~10% of patients on indinavir develop ureteral stones. Other culprits: ceftriaxone, ciprofloxacin, TMP-SMX, triamterene.
arabicExplanation: إندينافير (indinavir - مثبط بروتييز HIV) يتبلور في البول ويسبب حصى الحالب. ~10% من المرضى يطورون حصى. أيضًا: ceftriaxone, ciprofloxacin, TMP-SMX.

question: What medication is preferred to help with the expulsion of a ureteral stone larger than 5 mm?
englishExplanation: Medical expulsive therapy for ureteral stones >5 mm: alpha-blockers (tamsulosin) are preferred over calcium channel blockers. Tamsulosin 0.4 mg daily.
arabicExplanation: العلاج الطارد للحصى (MET) للحصى >5 mm: tamsulosin (حاصر ألفا) هو الأفضل. الجرعة: 0.4 mg يوميًا.

question: A pregnant patient with colicky right flank pain, urine 100 RBCs/hpf, 500 WBCs/hpf with nitrates, hydronephrosis on US. What is the appropriate management?
englishExplanation: Infected obstructed nephrolithiasis in pregnancy requires admission with urology consultation. US is imaging of choice to avoid radiation. Narcotics preferred (NSAIDs contraindicated).
arabicExplanation: حصى الكلى المسدّ للكلى مع عدوى (infected obstructed nephrolithiasis) في الحمل: إدخال + استشارة مسالك بولية. الإيكو هو التصوير المفضل. NSAIDs ممنوعة في الحمل.

question: What is the most common misdiagnosis in a patient presenting with an expanding or rupturing abdominal aortic aneurysm?
englishExplanation: Kidney stones are the most common misdiagnosis for AAA - both present with back pain, abdominal/flank pain, nausea/vomiting. Consider AAA in men >60 with smoking history.
arabicExplanation: أكثر تشخيص خاطئ لتمدد الأبهر (AAA): حصى الكلى (nephrolithiasis) - كلاهما يظهر بألم ظهر وبطن وغثيان. اشتبه بـ AAA في الرجال >60 مع تاريخ تدخين.

question: Which diagnostic test is the least sensitive and specific for diagnosing nephrolithiasis?
englishExplanation: Abdominal x-ray has lowest sensitivity (29-58%) and specificity (69-74%) for nephrolithiasis. CT (94-97% sens, 96-99% spec) and renal US (63-85% sens, 79-100% spec) are preferred.
arabicExplanation: صورة البطن البسيطة (abdominal x-ray) هي الأقل حساسية ونوعية للحصى (29-58% حساسية). CT (96-99% نوعية) والإيكو الكلوي هما الأفضل.

question: A 70-year-old man with left flank pain, BP 100/50, P 120, T 38.3°C. CT: 5-mm mid-ureteral stone. UA: nitrites, 4+ bacteria, WBC 50-100/hpf. What is the most appropriate management?

options.text: Ceftriaxone IV and emergent urology consultation
Cephalexin PO and outpatient urology follow-up
Ciprofloxacin IV and outpatient urology follow-up
Tamsulosin PO and urgent urology consultation

correctAnswer: Ceftriaxone IV and emergent urology consultation
englishExplanation: Infected kidney stone with sepsis signs (hypotension, tachycardia) is a surgical emergency. IV antibiotics (3rd-gen cephalosporin) + emergent urology for stone retrieval.
arabicExplanation: حصى الكلى المصحوب بعدوى + علامات إنتان (hypotension, tachycardia): طارئ جراحي. مضادات حيوية وريدية + استشارة مسالك عاجلة لاستخراج الحصى.

question: Which characteristic is associated with an increased prevalence of kidney stones?
englishExplanation: Kidney stones more common in Caucasians, males, obesity, high meat diet, diabetes. Other risks: gout, hyperparathyroidism, immobilization, dehydration, excess salt intake.
arabicExplanation: الحصى الكلوية أكثر شيوعًا في: القوقازيين، الذكور، السمنة، النظام الغني باللحوم، السكري. عوامل أخرى: النقرس، فرط جارات الدرق، عدم الحركة، الجفاف.

question: What is the most common solute found in kidney stones?
englishExplanation: Calcium oxalate/phosphate stones account for ~90% of kidney stones. Uric acid ~8%, struvite ~1%, cystine ~1%. Hematuria present in 85% of cases.
arabicExplanation: الكالسيوم (calcium oxalate/phosphate) يمثل ~90% من حصى الكلى. حمض البوليك ~8%، struvite ~1%، cystine ~1%. البيلة الدموية موجودة في 85% من الحالات.

question: A 34-year-old man with family history of kidney problems and painless hematuria. US shows multiple cysts. Which serious complication is he at risk for?
englishExplanation: ADPKD (autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease) - most common inherited cause of ESRD. Associated with 4x increased risk of cerebral aneurysms. Classic presentation: thunderclap headache + meningismus.
arabicExplanation: داء الكلى المتعدد الكيسات الوراثي السائد (ADPKD): أكثر سبب وراثي للفشل الكلوي النهائي. يترافق مع 4 أضعاف خطر أم الدم الدماغية (cerebral aneurysm). العرض: صداع رعدي + تصلب رقبي.

question: Which medication combination is most likely to trigger serotonin syndrome?
englishExplanation: Serotonin syndrome risk increases with two serotonergic agents. Citalopram (SSRI) + dextromethorphan (OTC cough suppressant with serotonin reuptake inhibition) is a classic combination.
arabicExplanation: متلازمة السيروتونين (serotonin syndrome): تحدث عند الجمع بين دوائين سيروتونيين. citalopram (SSRI) + dextromethorphan (مثبط سعال يثبط استرداد السيروتونين) مزيج كلاسيكي.

question: Which physical finding is most specific for serotonin syndrome?
englishExplanation: New-onset clonus in the setting of serotonergic agent use is highly specific for serotonin syndrome. Hunter criteria rely heavily on clonus. Rigidity, hyperthermia, and tachycardia are sensitive but nonspecific.
arabicExplanation: الرجفان العضلي (clonus) هو الأكثر نوعية لمتلازمة السيروتونين. معايير Hunter تعتمد عليه بشكل كبير. الصلابة (rigidity) والحرارة والسرعة ليست نوعية.

question: Which medication should be avoided to prevent serotonin syndrome after an uncomplicated intubation of a patient taking paroxetine?
englishExplanation: Paroxetine is an SSRI. Fentanyl has serotonergic properties and can precipitate serotonin syndrome. Dexmedetomidine, midazolam, and propofol lack serotonergic properties.
arabicExplanation: الباروكستين (paroxetine) هو SSRI. الفنتانيل (fentanyl) له خصائص سيروتونينية وقد يسبب متلازمة السيروتونين. البدائل الآمنة: dexmedetomidine, midazolam, propofol.

question: Cyproheptadine is the preferred agent to treat which condition?
englishExplanation: Cyproheptadine is the main antidote for serotonin syndrome. It is a first-generation antihistamine with unique serotonin receptor antagonism. Reserved for cases failing supportive care.
arabicExplanation: سايبروهيبتادين (cyproheptadine) هو الترياق الرئيسي لمتلازمة السيروتونين. مضاد هيستامين من الجيل الأول مع تثبيط مستقبلات السيروتونين. يُحفظ للحالات المقاومة.

question: A patient with opioid use disorder on methadone presents with altered mental status, hyperthermia, and sustained clonus. Started a new medication yesterday. Which likely precipitated this?
englishExplanation: Sumatriptan (triptan) is a serotonin receptor agonist. Combined with methadone (serotonergic) causes serotonin syndrome. Clonus is the most specific finding.
arabicExplanation: سوماتريبتان (sumatriptan) ناهض لمستقبلات السيروتونين. مع الميثادون (methadone - سيروتونيني) يسبب متلازمة السيروتونين. الرجفان العضلي هو الأكثر نوعية.

question: How do patients with alcoholic ketoacidosis most commonly present?

options.text: Altered mental status due to intoxication

englishExplanation: Alcoholic ketoacidosis typically occurs in undernourished alcoholics after a binge. Abdominal pain and vomiting are common. Normal mental status despite severe acidosis distinguishes from toxic alcohol.
arabicExplanation: الحماض الكيتوني الكحولي (alcoholic ketoacidosis): ألم بطني وقيء شائعان. المستوى العقلي طبيعي رغم الحماض الشديد - يميزه عن التسمم بالكحولات السامة.

question: What distinguishes the ethanol metabolism of chronic users from users intolerant of ethanol?

options.text: Clinical intoxication at ethanol levels >80 mg/dL
Metabolism occurs at a slower rate

englishExplanation: In chronic users, alcohol dehydrogenase becomes saturated and ethanol follows zero-order kinetics (fixed amount per hour). Tolerance develops so they may appear sober at higher levels.
arabicExplanation: في شاربي الكحول المزمنين: إنزيم ADH يشبع ويتبع الأيض حركية الرتبة الصفرية (كمية ثابتة/ساعة). يتطور التحمل فيبدون واعين بمستويات مرتفعة.

question: A patient with elevated anion gap acidosis. Blood gas lactate 19 mmol/L; serum lactate 3.4 mmol/L. What is the most likely causative agent?
englishExplanation: Ethylene glycol causes 'lactate gap' - glycolate metabolite falsely interpreted as lactate by blood gas analyzers (lactate oxidase). Serum lactate (LDH method) is unaffected.
arabicExplanation: إيثيلين غليكول (ethylene glycol): يسبب 'lactate gap' - مستقلب glycolate يُفسر خطأً كللاكتات في أجهزة غازات الدم. قياس اللاكتات في المصل لا يتأثر.

question: Which ingestion is associated with VBG pH 7.29, pCO2 29, Na 141, K 3.9, Cl 101, HCO3 14, BUN 21, Cr 2.4, glucose 97, lactate 0.7, calcium oxalate crystals in urine?
englishExplanation: Ethylene glycol classically produces metabolic acidosis with anion and osmolar gaps, AKI, and calcium oxalate crystals in urine. Osmolar and anion gaps are inversely related.
arabicExplanation: إيثيلين غليكول (ethylene glycol): حماض استقلابي مع فجوة أنيونية وأسمولية + AKI + بلورات أوكزالات الكالسيوم في البول. الفجوتان معكوستان.

question: A 54-year-old man with alcohol abuse presents with altered mental status and vomiting. P 116. Normal anion gap, normal glucose, ketonuria. What is the best next step?
englishExplanation: Isopropyl alcohol intoxication - ketosis with normal anion gap (no metabolic acidosis). Treatment is supportive: IV hydration, thiamine, folate. No role for fomepizole.
arabicExplanation: تسمم كحول الأيزوبروبيل (isopropyl alcohol): كيتوز بدون حماض استقلابي ولا فجوة أنيونية. العلاج داعم: سوائل وريدية، ثيامين، فولات. لا دور للفوميبزول.

question: In which scenario of known methanol ingestion is immediate treatment with both fomepizole and hemodialysis most indicated?

options.text: pH/pCO2 7.10/10; methanol level 0 mg/dL; ethanol level 0 mg/dL
pH/pCO2 7.10/10; methanol level 80 mg/dL; ethanol level 0 mg/dL
pH/pCO2 7.10/10; methanol level 80 mg/dL; ethanol level 250 mg/dL
pH/pCO2 7.40/40; methanol level 80 mg/dL; ethanol level 0 mg/dL

correctAnswer: pH/pCO2 7.10/10; methanol level 80 mg/dL; ethanol level 0 mg/dL
englishExplanation: Fomepizole prevents further metabolism of methanol; hemodialysis removes formic acid and corrects acidemia. Both indicated with severe acidemia + persistent methanol.
arabicExplanation: فوميبزول (fomepizole) يمنع استقلاب الميثانول. الغسيل الكلوي يزيل حمض الفورميك ويصحح الحماض. كلاهما مُستطب في الحماض الشديد مع بقاء الميثانول.

question: A 3-year-old girl with fever 3 days, given acetaminophen every 2 hours. What is the correct use of N-acetylcysteine?

options.text: It has a black box warning and should not be used
It is contraindicated because of the patient's age
It should be guided by specific laboratory tests
It should follow the Rumack-Matthew nomogram

correctAnswer: It should be guided by specific laboratory tests
englishExplanation: Rumack-Matthew nomogram is only for acute single-ingestion overdose. This is subacute/chronic overdose - NAC treatment guided by acetaminophen level, LFTs, and clinical status.
arabicExplanation: مخطط Rumack-Matthew مخصص فقط للجرعة الزائدة الحادة الأحادية. هذه حالة جرعة زائدة تحت حادة/مزمنة - يُوجه العلاج بـ NAC حسب المستوى ووظائف الكبد.

question: An awake and alert patient presents 2 hours after an overdose of acetaminophen. What action should come first?
englishExplanation: Activated charcoal should be given ASAP in patients presenting within several hours of ingestion. Acetaminophen level at 4 hours to plot on Rumack-Matthew. NAC guided by nomogram.
arabicExplanation: الفحم المنشط (activated charcoal) يجب أن يُعطى بأسرع وقت في أول ساعات ما بعد الجرعة الزائدة. قياس الأسيتامينوفين عند 4 ساعات ثم NAC حسب المخطط.

question: A 15-year-old presents with abdominal pain, vomiting, drowsiness. Labs: metabolic acidosis, AKI. Drug test negative. What is the most likely ingested substance?
englishExplanation: Ibuprofen overdose: large ingestions (>400 mg/kg) cause seizures, coma, renal failure, metabolic acidosis. Not routinely tested in drug screens. Treatment supportive.
arabicExplanation: جرعة زائدة من الإيبوبروفين (ibuprofen): >400 mg/kg تسبب اختلاجات وغيبوبة وفشل كلوي وحماض استقلابي. لا يُكشف عادةً في فحوصات المخدرات الروتينية.

question: A 16-year-old found unresponsive. pH 7.07, CO2 27, Cr 1.54, K 5.4, HCO3 13. Salicylates and acetaminophen negative. What is the most likely ingestion?
englishExplanation: Massive ibuprofen overdose causes seizures, coma, acidosis, AKI, hyperkalemia. Salicylate screen negative excludes oil of wintergreen. Treatment: fluids, bicarb, dialysis if severe.
arabicExplanation: جرعة كبيرة من إيبوبروفين: اختلاجات، غيبوبة، حماض، فشل كلوي، فرط بوتاسيوم. سكرين الساليسيلات سلبي يستبعد زيت wintergreen.

question: What is a clinical manifestation of opioid withdrawal?
englishExplanation: Opioid withdrawal: piloerection (goosebumps), diarrhea, tachycardia, mydriasis, rhinorrhea, yawning. NOT life-threatening. Constipation and miosis are signs of opioid intoxication.
arabicExplanation: انسحاب الأفيونات: انتصاب الشعر (piloerection/goosebumps)، إسهال، تسرع قلب، توسع حدقة، سيلان أنفي، تثاؤب. الإمساك وتضيق الحدقة علامات تسمم.

question: A patient on multiple psychiatric medications presents in severe opioid withdrawal. Which medication is best to manage the withdrawal?
englishExplanation: Buprenorphine is a high-affinity partial opioid agonist - safer than methadone when psychiatric meds prolong QT. Buccal preparation with naloxone discourages misuse.
arabicExplanation: البيبري نورفين (buprenorphine): ناهض جزئي عالي الألفة لمستقبلات الأفيون. أأمن من الميثادون خاصة مع أدوية نفسية تُطيل QT.

question: For which ingested agent is it most appropriate to administer activated charcoal?
englishExplanation: Aspirin is well absorbed by charcoal. Avoid charcoal with alcohols (rapid absorption), metals (poor binding), and caustics (contraindicated).
arabicExplanation: الأسبرين (acetylsalicylic acid) يُمتز جيدًا بالفحم. تجنب الفحم مع: الكحولات (امتصاص سريع)، المعادن (ارتباط ضعيف)، المواد الكاوية (ممنوعة).

question: Which finding is an indication for hemodialysis in the setting of acute salicylate poisoning?
englishExplanation: EXTRIP guidelines for hemodialysis in salicylate toxicity: altered mental status, salicylate >100 mg/dL, salicylate >90 with renal impairment, hypoxemia, failure of standard therapies.
arabicExplanation: استطبابات غسيل الكلى في تسمم الساليسيلات (EXTRIP): تغير الحالة العقلية، مستوى >100 mg/dL، >90 مع قصور كلوي، نقص أكسجة، فشل العلاج القياسي.

question: Which aspect of the physical examination can best distinguish anticholinergic from sympathomimetic toxicity?
englishExplanation: Dry skin = anticholinergic; damp/sweaty skin = sympathomimetic. Both cause tachycardia, mydriasis, and hyperthermia.
arabicExplanation: الجلد الجاف = مضاد الكولين (anticholinergic). الجلد الرطب/المتعرق = ودّي المفعول (sympathomimetic). كلاهما يسبب تسرع قلب وتوسع حدقة وحرارة.

question: Which medication is most likely to produce an anticholinergic toxidrome in overdose?
englishExplanation: Tricyclic antidepressants (imipramine) cause anticholinergic toxicity: tachycardia, hyperthermia, dry skin, mydriasis, urinary retention. Also cause sodium channel blockade (QRS widening).
arabicExplanation: مضادات الاكتئاب ثلاثية الحلقات (imipramine) تسبب تسممًا مضادًا للكولين: تسرع قلب، حرارة، جلد جاف، توسع حدقة، احتباس بول + حصار قنوات الصوديوم (QRS واسع).

question: What is a major feature of the anticholinergic toxidrome?
englishExplanation: Anticholinergic toxidrome: altered mental status, tachycardia, dry mucous membranes, dry flushed skin, mydriasis, urinary retention. Bronchorrhea and diaphoresis are cholinergic. Clonus is serotonin syndrome.
arabicExplanation: التسمم المضاد للكولين: تغير الحالة العقلية، تسرع قلب، أغشية جافة، جلد جاف ومحتقن، توسع حدقة، احتباس بول.

question: Which medication produces predominantly anticholinergic effects at therapeutic doses?
englishExplanation: Scopolamine is a pure anticholinergic. Amitriptyline and diphenhydramine have anticholinergic properties but also other effects at therapeutic doses. Physostigmine is a cholinesterase inhibitor.
arabicExplanation: سكوبولامين (scopolamine): مضاد كولين نقي. الأميتريبتيلين والديفينهيدرامين لهما تأثيرات مضادة للكولين لكن مع تأثيرات أخرى عند الجرعات العلاجية.

question: When considering physostigmine for the treatment of an anticholinergic toxidrome, what is an absolute contraindication?
englishExplanation: Physostigmine is contraindicated with QRS widening (>100 ms) due to risk of cardiac arrest, especially with sodium channel-blocking drugs (TCAs).
arabicExplanation: فيزيوستيغمين (physostigmine) ممنوع عند اتساع QRS (>100 ms) لخطر توقف القلب، خاصة مع الأدوية الحاصرة لقنوات الصوديوم (مضادات الاكتئاب ثلاثية الحلقات).

question: A 15-year-old with altered sensorium after suspected overdose. Which constellation is most consistent with diphenhydramine overdose?
englishExplanation: Diphenhydramine (anticholinergic) overdose: hallucinations, mydriasis, delirium, agitation, tachycardia, decreased bowel sounds, dry skin, seizures, QRS widening.
arabicExplanation: جرعة زائدة من ديفينهيدرامين: هلاوس، توسع حدقة، هذيان، هياج، تسرع قلب، جلد جاف، اختلاجات، اتساع QRS.

question: A currently asymptomatic patient reports massive diphenhydramine overdose. What is the most important next step?
englishExplanation: Diphenhydramine can cause sodium channel blockade, QRS widening, ventricular tachycardia, cardiogenic shock. Cardiac monitoring minimum 6 hours after reported ingestion.
arabicExplanation: ديفينهيدرامين يمكن أن يسبب حصار قنوات الصوديوم واتساع QRS وتسارع بطيني وصدمة قلبية. المراقبة القلبية لمدة 6 ساعات على الأقل بعد الجرعة المبلغ عنها.

question: Which metabolic complication is most likely to occur with both the therapeutic use and overdose of valproic acid?
englishExplanation: Hyperammonemia is a potential complication of both therapeutic use and overdose of valproic acid. Carnitine administration is the primary treatment.
arabicExplanation: فرط أمونيا الدم (hyperammonemia) مضاعفة محتملة للاستخدام العلاجي وللجرعة الزائدة من فالبروات. الكارنيتين هو العلاج.

question: An overdose of which antidepressant is most likely to cause the ECG changes shown (tachycardia, QRS widening, terminal rightward axis)?
englishExplanation: TCA overdose (amitriptyline) causes sodium channel blockade: tachycardia, QRS prolongation, prominent R wave in aVR. Treatment: sodium bicarbonate.
arabicExplanation: جرعة زائدة من مضادات الاكتئاب ثلاثية الحلقات (amitriptyline): حصار قنوات الصوديوم → تسرع قلب، اتساع QRS، موجة R بارزة في aVR. العلاج: بيكربونات الصوديوم.

question: A patient intentionally overdosed on paroxetine 6 hours ago. Asymptomatic, normal vitals. What lab test is most useful to guide management?
englishExplanation: Acetaminophen concentration should be checked in all intentional self-poisonings because toxicity is initially asymptomatic and NAC is highly effective if given early.
arabicExplanation: قياس الأسيتامينوفين يجب أن يُطلب في كل جرعة زائدة متعمدة لأن التسمم لا أعراض له في البداية و NAC فعال جدًا إذا أُعطي مبكرًا.

question: Which property of tricyclic antidepressants is responsible for the QRS prolongation seen with TCA toxicity?
englishExplanation: Sodium channel blockade causes QRS prolongation. Alpha-1 blockade causes hypotension; antimuscarinic effects cause tachycardia/dry skin; potassium blockade causes QT prolongation.
arabicExplanation: حصار قنوات الصوديوم يسبب اتساع QRS. حصار ألفا-1 يسبب هبوط ضغط. التأثيرات المضادة للكولين تسبب تسرع قلب وجفاف جلد.

question: A patient after acute amitriptyline ingestion. ECG: tachycardia, QRS prolongation, terminal rightward axis. What is the most appropriate treatment?
englishExplanation: Sodium bicarbonate is the first-line treatment for TCA-induced sodium channel blockade. Increased sodium load overcomes blockade; alkalinization decreases tissue distribution.
arabicExplanation: بيكربونات الصوديوم هي العلاج الأول لحصار قنوات الصوديوم من مضادات الاكتئاب ثلاثية الحلقات. زيادة الصوديوم تتغلب على الحصار، والقلوية تقلل التوزيع النسيجي.

question: A 19-year-old with restlessness and dystonia, neck twisted to the side. On promethazine and loperamide for 2 days. What medication should be administered?
englishExplanation: Acute dystonic reaction from dopamine antagonist (promethazine). First-line: diphenhydramine (anticholinergic). Also benztropine or benzodiazepines.
arabicExplanation: تفاعل خللي حاد (acute dystonic reaction) من مضادات الدوبامين (promethazine). العلاج الأول: diphenhydramine (مضاد كولين). بدائل: benztropine أو بنزوديازيبين.

question: What does linezolid inhibit, which can lead to potentially dangerous drug interactions?
englishExplanation: Linezolid is a nonspecific MAOI. Combines with SSRIs to cause serotonin toxicity; with sympathomimetics to cause hypertensive crisis; with tyramine-rich foods to cause hypertensive crisis.
arabicExplanation: linezolid هو مثبط غير نوعي لـ MAO. مع SSRIs يسبب تسمم سيروتونين. مع الودّيات يسبب نوبة ضغطية. مع الأطعمة الغنية بالتيرامين يسبب أزمة ضغطية.

question: A 21-year-old woman with recurrent seizures after ingesting a large quantity of isoniazid. Normal glucose. Which drug should be given IV?
englishExplanation: Isoniazid overdose: seizures refractory to conventional therapy + metabolic acidosis. Antidote: pyridoxine (vitamin B6). INH depletes GABA precursors.
arabicExplanation: جرعة زائدة من أيزونيازيد: اختلاجات مقاومة للعلاج + حماض استقلابي. الترياق: بيريدوكسين (vitamin B6).

question: A 52-year-old woman on chloroquine for malaria prophylaxis presents with cyanosis and dyspnea. SpO2 86% not improving with O2. ABG shows chocolate-brown blood. Which antidote?
englishExplanation: Chloroquine-induced methemoglobinemia. Methylene blue is the antidote. Pulse oximetry reading is falsely low (~85%) and doesn't respond to oxygen.
arabicExplanation: الميتهيموغلوبينية (methemoglobinemia) من الكلوروكين. العلاج: methylene blue. قراءة SpO2 منخفضة كاذبة (~85%) ولا تستجيب للأكسجين.

question: A 40-year-old man with confusion, fever, hyporeflexia. Tachycardic, diaphoretic, hypertensive, generalized rigidity. T 38.5°C. On clonazepam and haloperidol. What is the most likely diagnosis?
englishExplanation: NMS from haloperidol: fever, autonomic dysfunction, altered mentation, 'lead pipe' rigidity, HYPOREFLEXIA. Distinguish from serotonin syndrome (hyperreflexia, clonus).
arabicExplanation: متلازمة الخباثة العصبية (NMS) من الهالوبيريدول: حمى، خلل وظائف ذاتية، تغير وعي، صلابة 'أنبوب الرصاص'، نقص المنعكسات. تختلف عن متلازمة السيروتونين (فرط منعكسات، clonus).

question: A 30-year-old man with schizophrenia presents with severe agitation and restlessness. Vitals normal, alert, no muscle involvement. Haloperidol dose increased last week. What is the most likely diagnosis?
englishExplanation: Akathisia: severe restlessness/agitation after antipsychotic initiation or dose increase. Treatment: reduce dose, benzodiazepines, propranolol. Major reason for medication noncompliance.
arabicExplanation: الأكاثيزيا (akathisia): تململ شديد وهياج بعد بدء أو زيادة مضادات الذهان. العلاج: تخفيض الجرعة، بنزوديازيبين، propranolol. سبب رئيسي لعدم الالتزام بالدواء.

question: A 37-year-old man presents with ataxia, headache, and nausea after using a gas-powered generator indoors and passing out. Carboxyhemoglobin level 26%. What is the best first step in management?

options.text: Transport to the nearest hyperbaric oxygen facility

englishExplanation: CO poisoning: remove from source + 100% oxygen via nonrebreather. Half-life of carboxyhemoglobin drops from 5 hours (room air) to ~1 hour on 100% O2. Serial measurements unnecessary.
arabicExplanation: تسمم أول أكسيد الكربون (CO): إزالة المصدر + أكسجين 100% عبر قناع. نصف عمر الكاربوكسي هيموغلوبين ينخفض من 5 ساعات إلى ~ساعة. لا حاجة للقياسات المتكررة.

question: A 40-year-old man with carboxyhemoglobin 20%, normal neuro exam, on nonrebreather. What is the rationale for hyperbaric oxygen?

options.text: To decrease the likelihood of delayed neurologic sequelae
To decrease the risk of death over the next month
To prevent the potential development of a coma
To prevent the risk of acute cardiac dysrhythmias

correctAnswer: To decrease the likelihood of delayed neurologic sequelae
englishExplanation: HBO for CO poisoning primarily decreases risk of persistent/delayed neurologic sequelae. Risk factors: age >35, LOC, abnormal cerebellar exam, COHb >25%, seizures, prolonged exposure.
arabicExplanation: العلاج بالأكسجين عالي الضغط (HBO) يقلل خطر المضاعفات العصبية المتأخرة (delayed neurologic sequelae). العوامل المؤهبة: عمر >35، فقدان وعي، COHb >25%، اختلاجات.

question: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy for carbon monoxide poisoning is most likely to reduce the risk of developing what condition?
englishExplanation: HBO reduces risk of delayed neurologic sequelae (DNS) - motor, sensory, neurocognitive changes. Best within 6 hours of exposure.
arabicExplanation: HBO يقلل خطر المضاعفات العصبية المتأخرة (DNS) - تغيرات حركية وحسية وإدراكية. الأفضل خلال 6 ساعات من التعرض.

question: Four household members present with headache and malaise that started at similar time the previous night. What test is most appropriate?
englishExplanation: CO poisoning - risk factors include multiple close contacts with similar symptoms, cold weather, atypical heating sources. Pulse oximetry is inaccurate. Treatment: high-flow O2.
arabicExplanation: تسمم CO - عوامل الخطر: عدة أفراد في نفس المنزل بأعراض مشابهة، طقس بارد، مصادر تدفئة غير تقليدية. مقياس التأكسج غير دقيق. العلاج: أكسجين عالي التدفق.

question: Which beta-blocker has class III antiarrhythmic properties, and why?
englishExplanation: Sotalol is a nonselective beta-blocker with additional potassium channel antagonist properties (class III). Causes QT prolongation and torsades de pointes risk.
arabicExplanation: سوتالول (sotalol): حاصر بيتا غير انتقائي مع خصائص مضادة لقنوات البوتاسيوم (صنف III). يطيل QT ويعرض للتورساد دي بوانت.

question: In the setting of chronic digoxin poisoning, which finding is the best indication for administering digoxin-specific antibody fragments?
englishExplanation: Digoxin-induced ventricular tachycardia (especially bidirectional VT) is life-threatening and requires digoxin-specific antibody fragments. In chronic toxicity, clinical status (arrhythmias) - not level or K - guides treatment.
arabicExplanation: تسرع بطيني ثنائي الاتجاه (bidirectional VT) من الديجوكسين: مهدد للحياة ويتطلب digoxin immune Fab. في التسمم المزمن، الحالة السريرية (اضطرابات النظم) هي الموجّه وليس المستوى أو البوتاسيوم.

question: What is an indication to administer digoxin-specific antibody fragments in an adult patient?
englishExplanation: Symptomatic bradyarrhythmia (lightheadedness, syncope) from digoxin toxicity is an indication for digoxin immune Fab. HR alone, visual changes, or 5 mg ingestion not sufficient.
arabicExplanation: أعراض بطء القلب (دوار، إغماء) من تسمم الديجوكسين: استطباب للـ digoxin immune Fab. تغيرات النظر أو مجرد بطء القلب بدون أعراض ليست كافية.

question: A 60-year-old man on digoxin presents with vomiting, dizziness, abdominal cramping. ECG shows ST scooping and U waves. K 5.7. Develops PVCs and bradycardia. What is the next best step?
englishExplanation: Acute digoxin toxicity with K >5.0, life-threatening arrhythmias, or ingestion >10 mg in adults requires digoxin immune Fab. ECG 'Salvador Dali' sign.
arabicExplanation: تسمم الديجوكسين الحاد مع K >5.0 واضطرابات نظم مهددة للحياة: العلاج هو digoxin immune FAB. علامة 'Salvador Dali' على ECG.

question: An overdose of what pharmaceutical can cause an opioid-like toxidrome?
englishExplanation: Clonidine (alpha-2 agonist) overdose causes opioid-like toxidrome: somnolence, miosis, hypotension, bradycardia. Naloxone can reverse some effects.
arabicExplanation: الكلونيدين (clonidine) - ناهض ألفا-2: يسبب تسممًا شبيهًا بالأفيونات (somnolence, miosis, bradycardia, hypotension). يمكن استخدام النالوكسون.

question: A 15-year-old girl presents after overdose with BP 87/45, P 111. What is the most likely exposure?
englishExplanation: Amlodipine (dihydropyridine CCB) causes hypotension with compensatory tachycardia. Other CCBs (diltiazem/verapamil) and beta-blockers cause bradycardia.
arabicExplanation: أملوديبين (dihydropyridine CCB): هبوط ضغط مع تسرع قلب تعويضي. الديلتيازيم والفيراباميل وحاصرات بيتا تسبب بطء القلب.

question: A patient arrives confused after a witnessed seizure. BP 87/48, P 53. ECG: sinus bradycardia, first-degree AV block, QRS 127 ms, QTc 501 ms. What is the most likely agent?
englishExplanation: Propranolol is unique among beta-blockers - causes sodium channel blockade in overdose: seizures, QRS widening, hypotension, bradycardia. Treatment: sodium bicarbonate.
arabicExplanation: بروبرانولول (propranolol) فريد بين حاصرات بيتا - حصار قنوات الصوديوم في الجرعة الزائدة: اختلاجات، QRS واسع، هبوط ضغط، بطء قلب. العلاج: بيكربونات الصوديوم.

question: A toddler is found with somnolence, miosis, and bradycardia. What is the most likely ingestion?
englishExplanation: Clonidine overdose: somnolence, miosis, bradycardia, hypertension (early) then hypotension. 'One pill can kill' in pediatrics. Naloxone may reverse.
arabicExplanation: الكلونيدين: نعاس، تضيق حدقة، بطء قلب، ارتفاع ضغط (مبكرًا) ثم هبوط. 'حبة واحدة قد تقتل' عند الأطفال. النالوكسون قد يعكس.

question: A patient presents with profound hypotension after amlodipine overdose. What is the best initial therapy?
englishExplanation: Amlodipine overdose causes vasoplegic shock - initial therapy is IV fluids + vasopressors (norepinephrine). High-dose insulin for severe cases with cardiogenic component.
arabicExplanation: جرعة زائدة من أملوديبين: صدمة توسعية وعائية (vasoplegic). العلاج الأولي: سوائل وريدية + رافعات وعائية (norepinephrine). الإنسولين عالي الجرعة للحالات الشديدة.

question: What is a unique feature of a beta-blocker overdose when compared to a calcium channel blocker overdose?
englishExplanation: Beta-blockers cause hypoglycemia (block beta-2 - prevent gluconeogenesis). CCBs cause hyperglycemia (block pancreatic beta-cell L-type Ca channels).
arabicExplanation: حاصرات بيتا تسبب هبوط سكر (hypoglycemia) لأنها تحاصر beta-2 وتمنع استحداث السكر. حاصرات قنوات الكالسيوم تسبب فرط سكر (hyperglycemia) لأنها تحاصر قنوات Ca في خلايا بيتا البنكرياسية.

question: Overdose of which substance is most likely to be successfully treated with high-dose glucagon?
englishExplanation: High-dose glucagon is first-line for beta-blocker overdose - bypasses blocked beta-1 receptors in cardiac myocytes. Metoprolol is a beta-blocker.
arabicExplanation: الغلوكاغون عالي الجرعة هو الخط الأول لجرعة بيتا بلوكر الزائدة - يتجاوز مستقبلات beta-1 المحصورة في عضلة القلب.

question: A patient with hypotension, bradycardia, and hyperglycemia following an overdose. What is the most likely diagnosis?
englishExplanation: CCB overdose: hypotension + bradycardia + hyperglycemia. High-dose insulin is first-line. Beta-blocker overdose: hypoglycemia, not hyperglycemia.
arabicExplanation: جرعة زائدة من حاصرات قنوات الكالسيوم (CCB): هبوط ضغط + بطء قلب + فرط سكر. الإنسولين عالي الجرعة هو الخط الأول.

question: What is the most appropriate treatment for calcium channel blocker overdose?
englishExplanation: High-dose insulin therapy is first-line for severe CCB overdose - overcomes CCB-induced impairment of cardiac myocyte metabolism. Lipid emulsion is rescue.
arabicExplanation: العلاج بالإنسولين عالي الجرعة هو الخط الأول لجرعة CCB الشديدة. مستحلب الدهون (lipid emulsion) علاج إنقاذي.

question: A patient after 120 tablets of 60 mg diltiazem. BP 75/36, P 35. After IV fluids, calcium, and atropine, BP 74/38, P 34. Which medication is most likely to stabilize?
englishExplanation: Severe CCB overdose after failing calcium and atropine requires vasopressors (norepinephrine). Increases heart rate and causes vasoconstriction to improve BP.
arabicExplanation: جرعة CCB شديدة بعد فشل الكالسيوم والأتروبين: يتطلب رافعات وعائية (norepinephrine). يرفع معدل القلب ويسبب تقبضًا وعائيًا لتحسين الضغط.

question: A toddler fell into a bucket of insecticide. What is an expected finding of carbamate poisoning?
englishExplanation: Carbamate poisoning = cholinergic toxidrome: SLUDGE/BBB (salivation, lacrimation, urination, defecation, GI upset, emesis, bronchorrhea, bronchospasm, bradycardia). Treatment: atropine.
arabicExplanation: تسمم الكاربامات: تسمم كوليني - SLUDGE/BBB. العلاج: أتروبين بجرعات متزايدة.

question: Which pharmacologic intervention is the mainstay of treatment for organophosphorus insecticide poisoning?
englishExplanation: Atropine is the mainstay for OP poisoning - reverses muscarinic effects. Pralidoxime prevents 'aging' of cholinesterase inhibition but does not take priority over atropine.
arabicExplanation: الأتروبين هو العلاج الأساسي لتسمم الفوسفات العضوية - يعكس التأثيرات المسكارينية. البراليدوكسيم يمنع 'التقدم في العمر' للإنزيم لكن لا يتقدم على الأتروبين.

question: A woman with suspected exposure to a chemical weapon develops seizures, constricted pupils, copious secretions, and generalized weakness. What is the most likely exposure?
englishExplanation: Sarin (nerve agent) produces cholinergic toxidrome: miosis, salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, GI upset, emesis, bronchospasm, weakness, seizures.
arabicExplanation: السارين (sarin) - عامل عصبي: تسمم كوليني - تضيق حدقة، إفرازات، إسهال، تشنج قصبي، ضعف، اختلاجات.

question: A moderately symptomatic patient has a presumed nerve agent exposure. What is the most important first step in management?
englishExplanation: Decontamination (removing clothes + soap and water) should occur before entry into healthcare facility to prevent secondary exposures. Nerve agents persist on skin/clothing.
arabicExplanation: التطهير (decontamination) - خلع الملابس + ماء وصابون - يجب أن يحدث قبل دخول المستشفى لمنع التعرض الثانوي.

question: A toddler from an orchard with suspected insecticide poisoning. Which signs and symptoms are expected in organophosphate toxicity?
englishExplanation: OP toxicity = cholinergic: SLUDGE/BBB. Bradycardia, emesis, cough (bronchorrhea/bronchospasm). Treatment: atropine + pralidoxime.
arabicExplanation: تسمم الفوسفات العضوية: SLUDGE/BBB - بطء قلب، قيء، سعال. العلاج: أتروبين + براليدوكسيم.

question: A farm worker develops blurred vision, drooling, cough, fasciculations, abdominal pain, diarrhea. What is the best initial treatment?
englishExplanation: OP poisoning - atropine first. Give 1-3 mg and double every 5 minutes until atropinization (dry secretions, no bronchospasm, adequate HR/BP).
arabicExplanation: تسمم الفوسفات العضوية: أتروبين أولًا. ابدأ 1-3 mg وضعف الجرعة كل 5 دقائق حتى 'الأتروبينة' (أغشية جافة، لا تشنج قصبي).

question: Which finding is most consistent with cyanide poisoning?
englishExplanation: Cyanide inhibits oxidative phosphorylation → anaerobic metabolism → lactic acidosis. Venous O2 is HIGH (cells can't extract O2). Reddish plasma from hydroxocobalamin, not cyanide.
arabicExplanation: السيانيد يثبط الفسفرة التأكسدية → حماض لبني. تشبع الأكسجين الوريدي مرتفع (الخلايا لا تستطيع استخراج O2). لون البلازما الأحمر من الهيدروكسوكوبالامين.

question: What is the most appropriate treatment for cyanide poisoning?
englishExplanation: Hydroxocobalamin (vitamin B12 precursor) binds cyanide → cyanocobalamin. First-line for cyanide poisoning. Also: sodium thiosulfate, sodium nitrite.
arabicExplanation: الهيدروكسوكوبالامين (hydroxocobalamin) يرتبط بالسيانيد → سيانوكوبالامين. الخط الأول لتسمم السيانيد.

question: A 5-year-old boy with blood lead level 50 mcg/dL, vomiting, headache, difficulty coloring and tying shoes. What is the best disposition?

options.text: Admit to the floor for inpatient chelation therapy
Admit to the ICU for inpatient chelation therapy
Discharge home with a case management consultation
Discharge home with outpatient chelation therapy

correctAnswer: Admit to the floor for inpatient chelation therapy
englishExplanation: Symptomatic lead poisoning (any level) OR level >70 requires hospitalization and chelation. ICU if encephalopathy. Asymptomatic 45-69: oral chelation.
arabicExplanation: التسمم بالرصاص العرضي (أي مستوى) أو >70: إدخال + علاج مخالب (chelation). ICU إذا اعتلال دماغي. بدون أعراض 45-69: chelation فموي.

question: Which agent has clinical manifestations of acute toxicity most similar to those of tetanus?
englishExplanation: Strychnine antagonizes glycine receptors → recurrent, episodic involuntary muscle contractions resembling tetanus. Sensorium preserved.
arabicExplanation: الستركنين (strychnine) يثبط مستقبلات الغليسين → تقلصات عضلية متكررة تشبه الكزاز. الوعي محفوظ.

question: Which treatment is contraindicated in the management of an agricultural worker with diaphoresis, fasciculations, hypersalivation, miosis, respiratory distress, and vomiting?
englishExplanation: Physostigmine is an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor - contraindicated in OP poisoning (would worsen cholinergic crisis). Atropine + pralidoxime are appropriate.
arabicExplanation: فيزيوستيغمين هو مثبط أستيل كولين إستراز - ممنوع في تسمم الفوسفات العضوية (يفاقم الأزمة الكولينية). الأتروبين والبراليدوكسيم مناسبان.

question: A 3-year-old bit into a glow-stick. Awake, alert, no distress. What is the best next step?

options.text: Get information about the time and amount of ingestion
Send blood samples for co-oximetry evaluation

correctAnswer: Get information about the time and amount of ingestion
englishExplanation: Glow-stick contents are nontoxic. First step in any ingestion: gather information about time, substance, amount. Poison Help Line: 1-800-222-1222.
arabicExplanation: محتويات عصا الإضاءة غير سامة. الخطوة الأولى في أي ابتلاع: معلومات عن الوقت والكمية والمادة. خط المساعدة: 1-800-222-1222.

question: Systemic toxicity is most likely to occur after topical dermal exposure to which acid?
englishExplanation: HF acid penetrates deeply (fluoride electronegativity) - causes systemic hypocalcemia and hypomagnesemia. Other acids cause coagulative necrosis limiting penetration.
arabicExplanation: حمض الهيدروفلوريك (HF) يخترق بعمق → نقص كالسيوم ومغنيزيوم جهازي. الأحماض الأخرى تسبب تنخرًا تخثريًا يحد من الاختراق.

question: Which electrolyte abnormality can occur after significant exposure to topical, concentrated hydrofluoric acid?
englishExplanation: HF acid: fluoride binds calcium and magnesium → hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hyperkalemia (K efflux). Treatment: calcium gluconate gel topically, IV calcium for systemic.
arabicExplanation: HF: الفلورايد يرتبط بالكالسيوم والمغنيزيوم → نقص كالسيوم ومغنيزيوم وفرط بوتاسيوم. العلاج: جل غلوكونات الكالسيوم موضعيًا.

question: A 14-year-old found unconscious with a wet rag, wide-complex dysrhythmia, SpO2 97% on NRB. What is the most likely cause?
englishExplanation: 'Huffing' hydrocarbons: CNS effects + cardiotoxicity ('sudden sniffing death') - sensitized myocardium to catecholamines. Avoid epinephrine.
arabicExplanation: استنشاق الهيدروكربونات (huffing): تأثيرات عصبية + سمية قلبية (sensitized myocardium). تجنب الإبينفرين.

question: An adult painter accidentally ingested methylene chloride. What is a consequence of methylene chloride ingestion?
englishExplanation: Methylene chloride is metabolized to CO - delayed 4-8 hours, prolonged half-life ~13 hours. Found in paint removers and degreasers.
arabicExplanation: كلوريد الميثيلين (methylene chloride) يُستقلب إلى CO - متأخر 4-8 ساعات، نصف عمر ~13 ساعة. يوجد في مزيلات الدهان.

question: An accidental ingestion of which single pill by a 1-year-old (10 kg) is potentially life-threatening?
englishExplanation: Sulfonylureas (glipizide) - even one pill can cause life-threatening hypoglycemia in children. Requires 12-24 hours observation. Treatment: dextrose + octreotide.
arabicExplanation: سلفونيل يوريا (glipizide): حتى حبة واحدة تسبب هبوط سكر مهدد للحياة عند الأطفال. مراقبة 12-24 ساعة. العلاج: دكستروز + أوكتريوتيد.

question: A patient ingested glyburide and presents with agitation. Which agent best treats the underlying cause?
englishExplanation: Octreotide (somatostatin analog) is first-line for sulfonylurea poisoning - antagonizes insulin release. Diazoxide is alternative. Glucagon less effective.
arabicExplanation: أوكتريوتيد (octreotide) - نظير السوماتوستاتين - هو الخط الأول لتسمم السلفونيل يوريا - يعاكس إفراز الإنسولين.

question: A 30-year-old woman with accidental IV bupivacaine injection, convulsion, then cardiac arrest. Besides standard resuscitation, what IV agent should be strongly considered?
englishExplanation: Lipid emulsion (intralipid) for local anesthetic systemic toxicity (LAST): 1.5 mL/kg bolus of 20%, then infusion 0.25 mL/kg/hr. Also for BB/CCB/TCA toxicity.
arabicExplanation: مستحلب الدهون (lipid emulsion/intralipid) لسمية المخدر الموضعي الجهازية (LAST): 1.5 mL/kg جرعة، ثم تسريب 0.25 mL/kg/hr.

question: Which local anesthetic is most likely to cause an allergic reaction?
englishExplanation: Amino ESTER anesthetics (proparacaine, procaine, tetracaine, benzocaine) - metabolized to PABA (allergen) - cause most allergic reactions. Amides (bupivacaine, lidocaine, mepivacaine) rarely cause allergy.
arabicExplanation: المخدرات الموضعية من نوع إستر (proparacaine, procaine, tetracaine, benzocaine) - تُستقلب إلى PABA (مسبب حساسية). الأميدات (lidocaine, bupivacaine) نادرًا ما تسبب حساسية.

question: A 32-year-old man with nausea, vomiting, mouth tingling, and hand burning when drinking iced water after seafood. What is the most likely cause?
englishExplanation: Ciguatera: GI + neurologic symptoms. Cold allodynia (pain from cold) is pathognomonic. Worsens with alcohol. From barracuda, grouper, snapper, etc.
arabicExplanation: السيغواتيرا (ciguatera): أعراض معوية + عصبية. ألم من البرد (cold allodynia) علامة مميزة. تتفاقم مع الكحول.

question: A 10-month-old with cyanosis, SpO2 85% not responding to O2, active and vigorous. Teething gel use. What is the most likely cause?
englishExplanation: Benzocaine in teething gel → methemoglobinemia. Pulse ox ~85% fixed, doesn't respond to O2. Treatment: methylene blue (1-2 mg/kg).
arabicExplanation: بنزوكايين في جل التسنين → ميتهيموغلوبينية (methemoglobinemia). SpO2 ~85% ثابت لا يستجيب للأكسجين. العلاج: methylene blue.

question: A 12-month-old with marked cyanosis, SpO2 86% not improving with high-flow O2, on teething gel. What is most likely to be successful in treating the cyanosis?
englishExplanation: Benzocaine-induced methemoglobinemia. Methylene blue converts methemoglobin back to Hgb (via G6PD pathway). Deferoxamine for iron, PGE1 for ductal-dependent, pyridoxine for INH.
arabicExplanation: ميتهيموغلوبينية من البنزوكايين. methylene blue يحول الميتهيموغلوبين إلى هيموغلوبين.

question: What role does oxygen administration play in the treatment of methemoglobinemia?

options.text: Increases arterial partial pressure of oxygen

correctAnswer: Increases arterial partial pressure of oxygen
englishExplanation: O2 increases PaO2 but does NOT correct cyanosis or SpO2 in methemoglobinemia. Only methylene blue reduces Hgb to ferrous state.
arabicExplanation: الأكسجين يرفع PaO2 لكنه لا يصحح الزرقة أو SpO2 في الميتهيموغلوبينية. فقط methylene blue يعيد الهيموغلوبين لحالة الحديدوز.

question: Ingestion of which is associated with delayed GI symptoms and hepatic failure?
englishExplanation: Amanita phalloides: delayed (>6 hours) GI symptoms then hepatic failure. Most deaths from wild mushroom ingestion in US. Other mushrooms: early symptoms = less toxic.
arabicExplanation: فطر أمانيتا: أعراض معوية متأخرة (>6 ساعات) ثم فشل كبدي. الأكثر فتكًا بين الفطور البرية في أمريكا.

question: A toddler ingests his mother's prenatal vitamin. Which component is most likely to cause toxicity?
englishExplanation: Iron: 10-30 mg/kg mild-moderate toxicity; >40-60 mg/kg severe. Prenatal vitamins ~30 mg elemental iron. Treatment: deferoxamine for severe.
arabicExplanation: الحديد: 10-30 mg/kg تسمم خفيف-متوسط؛ >40-60 mg/kg شديد. فيتامينات الحمل تحتوي ~30 mg حديد. العلاج: ديفيروكسامين للحالات الشديدة.

question: What is most likely to cause toxicity after acute overdose?
englishExplanation: Vitamin A: acute toxicity from animal livers (polar bear, seal, etc.). Symptoms: headache, papilledema, nausea, desquamation. Other vitamins need chronic overdose.
arabicExplanation: فيتامين A: سمية حادة من أكباد الحيوانات (دب قطبي، فقمة). أعراض: صداع، وذمة حليمة، غثيان، تقشر.

question: A 2-year-old in shock, unconscious, pale, icteric sclera, oozing from IV. Vomiting/diarrhea 2 days ago. pH 7.26. What is the best initial treatment?
englishExplanation: Phase 3 iron toxicity: shock, acidosis, hepatic failure. Deferoxamine is the chelator. Phase 1 = GI, Phase 2 = latent, Phase 3 = shock/liver failure, Phase 4 = pyloric stenosis.
arabicExplanation: المرحلة 3 من تسمم الحديد: صدمة، حماض، فشل كبدي. العلاج: ديفيروكسامين (deferoxamine).

question: What medication is recommended for the management of acute opioid withdrawal?
englishExplanation: Clonidine (alpha-2 agonist) treats opioid withdrawal symptoms by reducing central sympathetic outflow. Check BP/HR before giving. Alternatives: buprenorphine, methadone.
arabicExplanation: الكلونيدين (clonidine) - ناهض ألفا-2 - يقلل من الأعراض عبر تقليل التدفق السمبثاوي المركزي. تحقق من الضغط والنبض قبل الإعطاء.

question: What is a validated scoring system for the evaluation of opioid withdrawal in adults?
englishExplanation: Clinical Opiate Withdrawal Scale (COWS) - validated for adults. CIWA for alcohol, FNAST for neonatal, WAT-1 for pediatric.
arabicExplanation: مقياس COWS لانسحاب الأفيونات عند البالغين. CIWA للكحول، FNAST لحديثي الولادة، WAT-1 للأطفال.

question: What is a partial agonist of the mu opioid receptor?
englishExplanation: Buprenorphine = partial mu agonist - ceiling effect (lower overdose risk) + high affinity (blocks other opioids). Methadone/tramadol = full agonist; naloxone = antagonist.
arabicExplanation: ببرينورفين: ناهض جزئي لمستقبل mu - تأثير سقفي + ألفة عالية (يحاصر الأفيونات الأخرى).

question: Which signs and symptoms are typical of cannabis intoxication?

options.text: Ataxia, dry mucosa, mydriasis, hyponatremia, and rhabdomyolysis
Euphoria, decreased anxiety, enhanced sensations, and psychomotor slowing
Euphoria, diaphoresis, hypertension, mydriasis, and tachycardia

correctAnswer: Euphoria, decreased anxiety, enhanced sensations, and psychomotor slowing
englishExplanation: Cannabis: euphoria, decreased anxiety, enhanced sensations, psychomotor slowing, tachycardia, conjunctival injection. Peak within 15-45 min (smoked).
arabicExplanation: القنب: نشوة، انخفاض قلق، تعزيز الأحاسيس، تباطؤ نفسي حركي، تسرع قلب، احتقان ملتحمة.

question: What is the most effective long-term treatment of cannabinoid hyperemesis syndrome?
englishExplanation: Cannabinoid hyperemesis syndrome (CHS): recurrent vomiting + abdominal pain in chronic cannabis users. Abstinence is definitive. Hot showers provide temporary relief.
arabicExplanation: متلازمة التقيؤ المفرط بالقنب (CHS): تقيؤ متكرر + ألم بطني في مستخدمي القنب المزمنين. الامتناع هو العلاج النهائي. الاستحمام بالماء الساخن يخفف مؤقتًا.

question: A 20-year-old man took LSD and is having a 'bad trip'. Warm, tachycardic, flushed, paranoid, agitated, combative. Which treatment is indicated?
englishExplanation: Hallucinogen (LSD) toxicity - benzodiazepines (diazepam, lorazepam) for agitation/delirium. Also control hypertension and tachycardia.
arabicExplanation: تسمم الهلوسة (LSD): بنزوديازيبين (diazepam, lorazepam) للهياج والهذيان. أيضًا السيطرة على ارتفاع الضغط والتسرع.

question: A 15-year-old found unresponsive, P 40, R 12, T 36°C, no response to naloxone. Comatose 5 hours then suddenly wakes up. What agent?
englishExplanation: GHB: rapid recovery of consciousness from severely depressed CNS state is unique. Duration 3-8 hours. GABA-B agonist. Other sedatives have gradual recovery.
arabicExplanation: GHB: التعافي السريع من حالة تثبيط عصبي مركزي شديد فريد له. المدة 3-8 ساعات. ناهض GABA-B.

question: Flumazenil administration in benzodiazepine overdose should be considered in which scenario?
englishExplanation: Flumazenil - only for iatrogenic benzodiazepine overdose (procedural sedation). Contraindicated with TCA coingestion, seizure history, elevated ICP, chronic benzodiazepine use.
arabicExplanation: فلومازينيل (flumazenil) - فقط للجرعة الزائدة اليتروجينية من البنزوديازيبين (تهدئة إجرائية). ممنوع مع TCA أو تاريخ اختلاجات أو ICP مرتفع.

question: An overdose of what agent is associated with mental status and respiratory depression that resolves within hours?
englishExplanation: GHB overdose: rapid-onset, profound CNS + respiratory depression that resolves within hours. Hypothermia + bradycardia common. Treatment supportive.
arabicExplanation: جرعة زائدة GHB: تثبيط عصبي مركزي وتنفسي شديد سريع البدء يتعافى خلال ساعات. انخفاض حرارة وبطء قلب شائعان.

question: What is the mainstay of therapy in a toddler with suspected methamphetamine exposure?
englishExplanation: Methamphetamine (sympathomimetic) toxicity: mainstay is anxiolysis with benzodiazepines. Prevents hyperthermia, seizures, rhabdomyolysis.
arabicExplanation: تسمم الميثامفيتامين (sympathomimetic): العلاج الأساسي هو التهدئة بالبنزوديازيبين (anxiolysis). يمنع الحرارة والاختلاجات وانحلال الربيدات.

question: Which constellation of findings is expected after methamphetamine abuse?

options.text: Dilated pupils, hallucinations, and dry skin
Hyperreflexia, clonus, and torsades de pointes

englishExplanation: Methamphetamine: anxiety, agitation, choreoathetosis (repetitive movements), mydriasis, hallucinations, psychosis, tachycardia, sweating, hypertension.
arabicExplanation: ميثامفيتامين: قلق، هياج، حركات لا إرادية متكررة (choreoathetosis)، توسع حدقة، هلاوس، ذهان، تسرع، تعرق، ضغط مرتفع.

question: A 30-year-old man with chest pain after 2 days of cocaine use. BP 200/120, P 120, T 39.9°C, Cr 2.6, CPK 8500. Which treatment should be avoided?
englishExplanation: Cocaine toxicity: avoid beta-blockers (unopposed alpha stimulation → worsened hypertension). Use benzodiazepines, nitroglycerin, calcium channel blockers.
arabicExplanation: تسمم الكوكايين: تجنب حاصرات بيتا (تنبيه ألفا غير معاكس → ارتفاع ضغط أسوأ). استخدم بنزوديازيبين، نيتروغليسرين، حاصرات قنوات الكالسيوم.

question: A 23-year-old diabetic woman with confusion, palpitations, nausea after cocaine use. BP 165/89, P 130, R 28, glucose 440. Besides fluids and insulin, what medication should be given?
englishExplanation: Cocaine + DKA: benzodiazepines (lorazepam) for sympathomimetic symptoms. Avoid antipsychotics (lower seizure threshold, worsen tachycardia). Avoid beta-blockers.
arabicExplanation: الكوكايين + DKA: بنزوديازيبين (lorazepam) للأعراض الودّية. تجنب مضادات الذهان (تخفض عتبة الاختلاج) وحاصرات بيتا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: In which scenario is succinylcholine a safe alternative to rocuronium?

options.text: Left-sided weakness for the past 2 hours

correctAnswer: Left-sided weakness for the past 2 hours
englishExplanation: Succinylcholine contraindicated in ALS, MH history, recent amphetamines, and after 5 days of burns/crush/spinal cord injury/stroke. Acute stroke <5 days is safe (receptor upregulation takes days).
arabicExplanation: سكسينيل كولين ممنوع في: ALS، تاريخ MH، أمفيتامينات حديثة، وبعد 5 أيام من الحروق/الرضح/إصابة الحبل/السكتة. السكتة الحادة خلال 5 أيام آمنة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which method is most reliable for confirming correct tube placement after endotracheal intubation?
englishExplanation: End-tidal capnography is most reliable. Chest x-ray does NOT differentiate endotracheal vs esophageal - only identifies mainstem bronchus or too-high tube.
arabicExplanation: قياس ثاني أكسيد الكربون في نهاية الزفير (ETCO2/capnography) هو الأكثر موثوقية. صورة الصدر لا تميز الأنبوب الرغامي عن المريئي.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which examination finding indicates that a child is likely to have a difficult airway?

options.text: Distance between mentum and thyroid is one finger breadth
Distance between upper and lower incisors is three finger breadths
Uvula and tonsillar pillars are partially visualized

correctAnswer: Distance between mentum and thyroid is one finger breadth
englishExplanation: Thyromental distance <2 finger breadths = independent predictor of difficult airway in children (micrognathia). Mallampati III/IV also concerning.
arabicExplanation: مسافة الفك-الدرق (thyromental distance) <2 عرض إصبع = متنبئ مستقل بصعوبة المسلك الهوائي عند الأطفال.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 65-year-old man with combativeness, SpO2 75%, uncooperative with NC and NRB. Needs intubation. What is the best next step?
englishExplanation: Delayed sequence intubation (DSI): ketamine 1-3 mg/kg dissociates patient without suppressing respiration → preoxygenate → paralyze → intubate. For agitated patients who can't tolerate preoxygenation.
arabicExplanation: التنبيب المتأخر (DSI): ketamine 1-3 mg/kg يفصل المريض دون تثبيط التنفس → أكسجة مسبقة → شلل → تنبيب. للمرضى الهائجين.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A patient with right ventricular failure (POCUS showing RV failure) becomes hypotensive with intubation. What should be given?
englishExplanation: RV failure (massive PE): push-dose epinephrine provides beta agonism (inotropic support for RV). Avoid phenylephrine (increases pulmonary vascular resistance, worsens RV failure).
arabicExplanation: فشل البطين الأيمن (PE ضخم): push-dose epinephrine يعطي تنبيه بيتا (دعم مقوٍ للـ RV). تجنب phenylephrine (يرفع المقاومة الرئوية).

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A man with ABG 7.01/20/80 needing intubation. Which intervention is appropriate?

options.text: Set high respiratory rate on the ventilator

correctAnswer: Set high respiratory rate on the ventilator
englishExplanation: Severe metabolic acidosis: match minute ventilation (respiratory rate) on ventilator. Avoid prolonged apnea. Sodium bicarb not shown to benefit.
arabicExplanation: الحماض الاستقلابي الشديد: طابق التهوية الدقيقة (معدل التنفس) على المنفسة. تجنب apnea المطول. بيكربونات الصوديوم لم تُثبت فائدة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which medication is contraindicated in patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy?
englishExplanation: Succinylcholine contraindicated in muscular dystrophy (risk of rhabdomyolysis and fatal hyperkalemia). FDA black box warning for pediatric use except emergency airway.
arabicExplanation: سكسينيل كولين ممنوع في الحثل العضلي (خطر انحلال الربيدات وفرط بوتاسيوم قاتل). تحذير FDA في الأطفال.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: RSI on a 3-year-old with etomidate and rocuronium. HR 58 → 127 bpm after ventilation. What is the most likely cause of the bradycardia?
englishExplanation: Hypoxia is most common cause of peri-intubation bradycardia in children. Resolves with successful intubation/ventilation. Etomidate is cardiovascular neutral; rocuronium doesn't cause bradycardia.
arabicExplanation: نقص الأكسجة هو السبب الأكثر شيوعًا لبطء القلب حول التنبيب عند الأطفال. يتحسن بالتنبيب/التهوية الناجح.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: For which patient would awake intubation be appropriate?

options.text: A crashing trauma patient with facial fractures and hypoxia
A patient with a GI bleed with recurrent hematemesis
A patient with angioedema involving the airway without respiratory distress
An anxious asthmatic patient in respiratory distress

correctAnswer: A patient with angioedema involving the airway without respiratory distress
englishExplanation: Awake intubation for potentially difficult airway + stable patient. Ideal: calm, stable, no distress, no vomiting risk. Angioedema without distress qualifies.
arabicExplanation: التنبيب اليقظ (awake intubation) للمسلك الهوائي الصعب المحتمل + مريض مستقر. وذمة وعائية بدون ضائقة تنفسية تفي بالمعايير.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the recommended sedative agent in awake intubation?
englishExplanation: Ketamine is the recommended sedative for awake intubation in ED. Dissociative state, preserves airway reflexes and spontaneous respiration. Add glycopyrrolate to reduce secretions.
arabicExplanation: الكيتامين هو المهدئ الموصى به للتنبيب اليقظ في الطوارئ. حالة تفارقية تحافظ على ردود فعل المسلك والتنفس التلقائي.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 3-year-old with severe laryngotracheitis, agitated, biphasic stridor, SpO2 82% on 10L. What is the most appropriate approach?
englishExplanation: Agitated child with airway edema: calm first (dark room, minimize touch, ketamine/dexmedetomidine). Agitation worsens obstruction. Optimize before intubation.
arabicExplanation: طفل هائج مع وذمة مسلك هوائي: اهدئه أولًا (غرفة مظلمة، لمس قليل، ketamine/dexmedetomidine). الهياج يفاقم الانسداد.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Intubating a 2-week-old infant for recurrent apneic episodes. Which tool is most helpful in reducing errors?
englishExplanation: Video laryngoscopy reduces errors in infants <10 kg (larger tongue, redundant glottic tissues, floppy epiglottis, anterior airway). Recommended first-line for anticipated difficult airway.
arabicExplanation: تنظير الحنجرة بالفيديو (video laryngoscopy) يقلل الأخطاء في الرضع <10 kg (لسان أكبر، أنسجة حنجرية رخوة، مسلك أمامي).

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: While removing a carrot piece obstructing a 2-year-old's airway, it's pushed through the glottis. SpO2 rapidly drops. What is the next best step?
englishExplanation: Subglottic foreign body: advance ETT to push FB into mainstem bronchus, then pull back to normal position. Specialist removes under bronchoscopy.
arabicExplanation: جسم غريب تحت المزمار: قدّم الأنبوب الرغامي لدفع الجسم إلى القصبة الرئيسية ثم أرجعه للوضع الطبيعي.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is contraindicated if the patient has an intact gag reflex?
englishExplanation: OPA contraindicated with intact gag reflex (can stimulate vomiting/aspiration). NPA safe with intact reflexes. OPA sized from corner of mouth to angle of mandible.
arabicExplanation: الأنبوب الفموي البلعومي (OPA) ممنوع مع وجود منعكس البلع. الأنبوب الأنفي البلعومي (NPA) آمن مع منعكس سليم.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is a contraindication to surgical cricothyrotomy?

options.text: Inability to orotracheally or digitally intubate

englishExplanation: Surgical cricothyrotomy contraindicated in children <5-10-12 years (small cricothyroid membrane, high complication rate). Needle cricothyrotomy is preferred for children.
arabicExplanation: بضع الغشاء الحلقي الدرقي الجراحي (surgical cricothyrotomy) ممنوع في الأطفال <5-12 سنة. يُفضل بضع الإبرة (needle cricothyrotomy).

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: An adult with angioedema becoming hypoxic after failed intubation and oxygenation. What is the best next approach?
englishExplanation: 'Can't intubate, can't oxygenate' in adult → cricothyrotomy. Needle cricothyrotomy for children <12 or adults as bridge. Tracheostomy if laryngeal fracture/tracheal transection.
arabicExplanation: 'لا تنبيب ولا أكسجة' في البالغ → cricothyrotomy. للاطفال <12 needle cricothyrotomy.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is a contraindication to emergent cricothyrotomy?
englishExplanation: Tracheal transection: trachea may have migrated into mediastinum → cricothyrotomy futile → tracheostomy required. Other contraindications: laryngeal fracture, <12 years.
arabicExplanation: قطع الرغامى (tracheal transection): الرغامى قد تكون انسحبت إلى المنصف → بضع الحلقوم ضروري.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the most common early complication of cricothyrotomy?
englishExplanation: Most common early complications: failure to place airway + damage to cartilaginous structures. Both result from incorrect technique.
arabicExplanation: المضاعفات المبكرة الأكثر شيوعًا: فشل إدخال المسلك + تلف الغضاريف. كلاهما من التقنية الخاطئة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the best device to use when performing an emergent cricothyrotomy in an adult?
englishExplanation: 6-mm tracheostomy tube is preferred (obturator helps insertion, easier to secure/suction, shorter). ETT 5-6 mm as alternative. Needle catheter for needle cricothyrotomy.
arabicExplanation: أنبوب بضع الحلقوم 6-mm هو الأفضل (وجود المسدد يسهل الإدخال، أقصر، أسهل في التثبيت والشفط).

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A patient with GSW to face, agonal respirations, SpO2 85%. BVM ineffective, intubation failed, SpO2 70%. What is the best next step?
englishExplanation: 'Can't intubate, can't ventilate, can't oxygenate' → immediate cricothyrotomy without delay. Do not waste time on repeated intubation attempts or consultations.
arabicExplanation: 'لا تنبيب ولا تهوية ولا أكسجة' → cricothyrotomy فورًا دون تأخير.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which patient is most likely to benefit from an emergent cricothyrotomy?

options.text: 6-year-old with mild lip and tongue swelling from anaphylaxis
20-year-old in status epilepticus whose pulse ox is rising with BVM
70-year-old with severe facial trauma, difficult to ventilate, hypoxic

correctAnswer: 70-year-old with severe facial trauma, difficult to ventilate, hypoxic
englishExplanation: Cricothyrotomy for adults >12 years with 'can't intubate, can't oxygenate'. Severe facial trauma + difficult ventilation + hypoxia qualifies.
arabicExplanation: بضع الحلقوم للبالغين >12 سنة مع 'لا تنبيب، لا أكسجة'. رضح وجه شديد + تهوية صعبة + نقص أكسجة يفي بالمعايير.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: An intubated patient has a high pressure alarm. Pressure-time curve with inspiratory hold shows high peak with normal plateau. What is the most likely cause?
englishExplanation: High peak + normal plateau = increased airway resistance (patient biting tube, mucus plug, bronchospasm, kinked tube). Inadequate sedation causes biting.
arabicExplanation: ذروة عالية + هضبة طبيعية = زيادة مقاومة المسلك الهوائي (عض الأنبوب، سدادة مخاطية، تشنج قصبي). التهدئة غير الكافية تسبب العض.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the most reliable method for confirming the endotracheal tube is in the trachea after intubation?
englishExplanation: ETCO2 directly measures exhaled CO2 - most reliable for confirming ETT placement. Also useful in cardiac arrest (ETCO2 >20 = high-quality CPR; jump >40 = ROSC).
arabicExplanation: ETCO2 يقيس ثاني أكسيد الكربون الزفيري مباشرة - الأكثر موثوقية لتأكيد وضع الأنبوب. مفيد في التوقف القلبي.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A nurse calls about an intubated patient with increasing ventilator alarms and 'bucking' the ventilator. BP 105/60, P 105, SpO2 90%. Which action should be taken first?
englishExplanation: Use DOPES mnemonic: Dislodgement, Obstruction, Pneumothorax, Equipment malfunction, Stacking. Check tube position first before assuming agitation.
arabicExplanation: استخدم اختصار DOPES: الانخلاع، الانسداد، استرواح الصدر، خلل الجهاز، تراكم الأنفاس. تحقق من وضع الأنبوب أولًا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Intubated patient suddenly becomes hypoxic and hypotensive, 'bucking' the ventilator. What is the best next step?
englishExplanation: DOTTS mnemonic: Disconnect, Oxygen 100%, Tube placement, Tweak vent, Sonogram. Disconnect and bag with 100% O2 to focus on the patient.
arabicExplanation: اختصار DOTTS: افصل، أكسجين 100%، وضع الأنبوب، عدّل المنفسة، إيكو. افصل واستخدم BVM مع 100% O2.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Ventilator alarms for high pressure. Inspiratory hold shows elevated peak AND elevated plateau. What is the most likely etiology?
englishExplanation: High peak + high plateau = decreased lung compliance (alveolar level). Causes: pneumothorax, ARDS, restrictive lung disease. High peak + normal plateau = airway resistance issue.
arabicExplanation: ذروة عالية + هضبة عالية = انخفاض مطاوعة الرئة (مستوى سنخي). الأسباب: استرواح الصدر، ARDS، أمراض رئوية تقييدية.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 50-kg adolescent with ARDS, hypoxic despite FiO2 100%. DOPES negative. Which ventilator parameter should be increased?
englishExplanation: Persistent hypoxemia despite high FiO2 in ARDS: increase PEEP (recruits alveoli, decreases shunt). Titrate by 2 cm H2O every 10-20 min. If PEEP >10 needed, consider escalation.
arabicExplanation: نقص أكسجة مستمر رغم FiO2 عالي في ARDS: ارفع PEEP (يجنّد السنخات ويقلل التحويلة).

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Approximately 20 minutes after intubation, a patient acutely develops severe respiratory distress, hypotension, and oxygen saturations in the 60s. What is the best next step?
englishExplanation: First step in decompensating ventilated patient: disconnect and bag with 100% O2. Then troubleshoot DOPES. Do not delay for imaging or auscultation.
arabicExplanation: أول خطوة في المريض المتفاقم على المنفسة: افصل ووصل BVM مع 100% O2. ثم استكشف DOPES.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 12-kg 2-year-old with status epilepticus is intubated (4.0 mm cuffed ETT). SIMV-PC mode. Which initial ventilator settings are most appropriate?

options.text: PIP 16, R 30, IT 0.8, PEEP 10, PS 8, FiO2 100%
PIP 20, R 24, IT 0.8, PEEP 5, PS 4, FiO2 100%
PIP 20, R 24, IT 0.8, PEEP 5, PS 8, FiO2 100%
PIP 24, R 18, IT 0.6, PEEP 5, PS 8, FiO2 100%

correctAnswer: PIP 20, R 24, IT 0.8, PEEP 5, PS 8, FiO2 100%
englishExplanation: Airway protection (no lung disease): low ventilatory support, PIP 15-20 above PEEP. PS = 8 for 4.0 mm ETT (based on tube resistance). PIP titrated to 6-8 mL/kg.
arabicExplanation: حماية المسلك الهوائي بدون مرض رئوي: دعم تنفسي منخفض، PIP 15-20 فوق PEEP. PS = 8 للأنبوب 4.0 mm.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: In which condition can noninvasive ventilation (NIV) be used safely?
englishExplanation: NIV contraindications: altered LOC, maxillofacial trauma, basilar skull fracture, life-threatening epistaxis, vomiting, severe hypotension. Hypertension is not a contraindication.
arabicExplanation: موانع NIV: تغير الوعي، رضح الوجه، كسر قاعدة الجمجمة، رعاف مهدد، قيء، هبوط ضغط شديد. ارتفاع الضغط ليس مانعًا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A ventilated ARDS patient on AC/VC: TV 420, R 22, FiO2 50%, PEEP 18. Plateau 26. ABG: 7.15/65/58. What strategy should be employed to correct pH?
englishExplanation: ARDS lung-protective: low TV (6 mL/kg). Permissive hypercapnia acceptable until pH <7.2. Increase respiratory rate (not TV) to improve ventilation. Keep rate <35.
arabicExplanation: ARDS: TV منخفض (6 mL/kg). فرط الكابنيا المسموح مقبول حتى pH <7.2. ارفع معدل التنفس (ليس TV) لتحسين التهوية.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: An intubated asthmatic with pH 7.28, pCO2 68. Flow curve shows air trapping. Which ventilator adjustment should be done first?
englishExplanation: Air trapping in asthma: prolong expiratory time. Decrease inspiratory time → increase expiratory time. Increasing rate/TV worsens trapping.
arabicExplanation: احتجاز الهواء في الربو: أطِل وقت الزفير. قلل وقت الشهيق → يزيد وقت الزفير. زيادة المعدل/TV يفاقم الاحتجاز.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Ventilator alarms for high pressure. Inspiratory hold shows elevated peak with NORMAL plateau. Which intervention best treats the underlying cause?
englishExplanation: High peak + normal plateau = airway resistance issue (mucus plug, kinking, bronchospasm). Suctioning treats mucous plug. Diuresis for pulmonary edema (high plateau).
arabicExplanation: ذروة عالية + هضبة طبيعية = مشكلة مقاومة المسلك (سدادة مخاطية، انثناء، تشنج). الشفط يعالج السدادة المخاطية.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: 63-inch-tall intubated man with bilateral infiltrates. VC: TV 550, PEEP 10, R 20, FiO2 50%. Plateau 35. ABG: 7.30/48/56, SpO2 89%. Best initial ventilator adjustment?
englishExplanation: ARDS: P:F ratio 112 = moderate ARDS. Plateau >30 → decrease TV to <6 mL/kg ideal body weight. Permissive hypercapnia acceptable.
arabicExplanation: ARDS: نسبة P:F 112 = متوسط. الهضبة >30 → قلل TV إلى <6 mL/kg. فرط الكابنيا المسموح مقبول.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Where should the tip of the laryngoscope blade be placed when performing direct laryngoscopy with a Macintosh blade?
englishExplanation: Macintosh (curved) blade: tip in vallecula (space anterior to epiglottis) → indirect lift of epiglottis via hyoepiglottic ligament. Miller (straight) blade: directly lifts epiglottis.
arabicExplanation: نصل ماكنتوش (منحني): الطرف في الوادي (vallecula) → رفع غير مباشر لسان المزمار. نصل ميلر (مستقيم): يرفع سان المزمار مباشرة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: When performing video-assisted laryngoscopy with a hyperangulated blade, what is the best option for stylet to use with the endotracheal tube?
englishExplanation: Hyperangulated video blade: use rigid hyperangulated stylet to maintain appropriate configuration. Standard malleable stylet loses shape; bougie too malleable.
arabicExplanation: نصل الفيديو شديد التقوس: استخدم ستايلت صلب شديد التقوس للحفاظ على الشكل. الستايلت العادي يفقد شكله.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Severe angioedema. Video laryngoscopy failed due to anterior oropharynx edema. Patient stable. What airway intervention should be attempted next?
englishExplanation: Awake nasotracheal fiberoptic intubation after failed video laryngoscopy in stable angioedema. Ketamine + topical lidocaine. Cricothyroidotomy if 'can't intubate, can't ventilate'.
arabicExplanation: التنبيب الأنفي بالمنظار الليفي (nasotracheal fiberoptic) بعد فشل تنظير الفيديو في وذمة وعائية مستقرة. cricothyroidotomy إذا 'لا تنبيب لا أكسجة'.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A patient with severe COPD exacerbation. BiPAP initiated. Which IPAP, EPAP, and FiO2 would be appropriate?
englishExplanation: BiPAP for COPD: IPAP 8-12, EPAP 3-5, FiO2 40-50%. IPAP must exceed EPAP. FiO2 40-50% to avoid suppressing respiratory drive (COPD).
arabicExplanation: BiPAP للـ COPD: IPAP 8-12، EPAP 3-5، FiO2 40-50%. IPAP يجب أن يتجاوز EPAP.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: An emergency physician is initiating HFNC oxygen therapy on a pediatric patient who weighs 5 kg. What is an appropriate initial flow rate?
englishExplanation: Pediatric HFNC: 1-2 L/kg/min. For 5 kg = 5-10 L/min. FiO2 25-30% in neonates. HFNC provides some PEEP (2-5 cm H2O).
arabicExplanation: HFNC للأطفال: 1-2 L/kg/min. لـ 5 kg = 5-10 L/min. FiO2 25-30% في حديثي الولادة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: An 85-year-old woman undergoing CPR with a durable and signed DNR order. Rhythm on arrival is VF. What is the next best step?

options.text: Ask the patient's daughter if she would like to continue resuscitation efforts

englishExplanation: Durable DNR is legally binding. Family disagreement does not override a signed DNR. Stop resuscitation and declare the patient deceased.
arabicExplanation: أمر DNR موثق قانونًا ملزم. لا يمكن للعائلة تجاوزه. أوقف الإنعاش وأعلن الوفاة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 57-year-old man in VF cardiac arrest. His son wishes to be in the room during resuscitation. Which statement is the best response?

options.text: 'I'm sorry, but you will be in the way of our team.'
'Of course. If you come with me, I'll have someone stand with you and explain everything.'
'Trust me, this is not how you want to remember your family member.'
'You can watch, but it may be more painful for you in the end.'

correctAnswer: 'Of course. If you come with me, I'll have someone stand with you and explain everything.'
englishExplanation: AHA Class I recommendation for family presence during CPR. Studies show decreased PTSD/anxiety in family members who witnessed. Supportive staff member should accompany them.
arabicExplanation: AHA توصي بحضور العائلة أثناء الإنعاش (Class I). الدراسات تظهر انخفاض PTSD والقلق لدى من حضر. يجب أن يرافقهم موظف داعم.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A woman at 39 weeks delivers a vigorous 2.9-kg baby precipitously. Covered in meconium. In respiratory distress despite stimulation. SpO2 88%. Which tube should be used for intubation?
englishExplanation: Cuffed ETTs for all pediatric intubations. ETT size by weight: <1 kg = 2.5; 1-2 kg = 3.0; 2-3 kg = 3.5; >3 kg = 3.5-4.0. Acrocyanosis can persist 24-48h - not an indicator of hypoxia.
arabicExplanation: أنابيب ذات كفة (cuffed ETT) لجميع الأطفال. الحجم حسب الوزن: 2-3 kg = 3.5. الزرقة الطرفية (acrocyanosis) يمكن أن تستمر 24-48 ساعة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 4-day-old with cyanosis, mottled skin, poor tone. SpO2 78% despite intubation and 100% O2. What is the most important initial pharmacologic treatment?
englishExplanation: Hyperoxia test failure (no improvement with 100% O2) = ductal-dependent cardiac lesion. PGE1 keeps ductus arteriosus patent. Side effects: apnea, hypotension.
arabicExplanation: فشل اختبار فرط الأكسجة (لا تحسن مع 100% O2) = آفة قلبية معتمدة على القناة. PGE1 يُبقي القناة مفتوحة. الآثار الجانبية: انقطاع نفس، هبوط ضغط.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A full-term baby delivered precipitously. Mother used heroin 1 hour ago. Poor inspiratory effort, P 58. What is the next best step?
englishExplanation: Neonatal resuscitation: dry/stimulate → jaw thrust + sniffing position if poor respiratory effort. Naloxone NOT recommended for maternal opioid use (insufficient data). Epinephrine only for P <60 after ventilation + compressions.
arabicExplanation: إنعاش حديثي الولادة: تجفيف/تحفيز → رفع الفك (jaw thrust) + وضع الشم إذا جهد تنفسي ضعيف. النالوكسون غير موصى به.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Where should the pulse oximeter be attached during neonatal resuscitation?
englishExplanation: Right upper extremity = preductal oxygen saturation. Ductal-dependent cardiac lesions may not be diagnosed prenatally. Normal SpO2 rises from 60-65% (1 min) to 85-95% (10 min).
arabicExplanation: الطرف العلوي الأيمن = تشبع قبل القناة (preductal). يبدأ 60-65% عند دقيقة ويصل 85-95% عند 10 دقائق.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: An emergency medicine resident is preparing to place an umbilical line for fluid and medication administration. Which labeled structure is the appropriate target?
englishExplanation: Umbilical vein (single, larger, flatter) for fluid/medications. Two umbilical arteries (smaller, rounder). Umbilical lines viable until 7 days.
arabicExplanation: الوريد السري (واحد، أكبر، مسطح) للسوائل والأدوية. شريانان سريان (أصغر، مستديران). الخطوط السريّة صالحة حتى 7 أيام.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the proper placement for an intraosseous line in a 3-year-old in cardiopulmonary arrest?

options.text: 2 cm below and medial to the proximal tibial tuberosity
Distal humerus, 2 cm above the lateral condyle

correctAnswer: 2 cm below and medial to the proximal tibial tuberosity
englishExplanation: IO preferred site: proximal tibia, 1-2 cm below and medial to tibial tuberosity. Direct needle perpendicular. Other sites: proximal humerus, distal femur, medial malleolus, iliac spine.
arabicExplanation: الموقع المفضل للـ IO: الظنبوب القريب، 1-2 cm تحت ووحشي الحدبة الظنبوبية. الإبرة عمودية.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: An 85-year-old after cardiac arrest, ROSC achieved. Awake, alert. ECG shows anteroseptal STEMI. What is the most important next step?
englishExplanation: Post-cardiac arrest with STEMI: activate cath lab for PCI. Therapeutic hypothermia for comatose patients (this patient is awake). Consider IABP/impella for refractory hypotension.
arabicExplanation: بعد ROSC مع STEMI: نشّط مخبر القسطرة لـ PCI. التبريد العلاجي للمرضى في غيبوبة (هذا المريض واعٍ).

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the most appropriate core temperature for targeted temperature management in a comatose post-cardiac arrest patient?
englishExplanation: TTM: 32-36°C for at least 24 hours. Avoid fever for 72 hours. Cooling methods: surface cooling machines, cold IV fluids, ice packs. Sedation +/- paralytics to prevent shivering.
arabicExplanation: TTM: 32-36°C لمدة 24 ساعة على الأقل. تجنب الحمى لمدة 72 ساعة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is a common complication of therapeutic hypothermia?
englishExplanation: TTM complications: coagulopathy (impaired platelet and clotting factor function starting at 35°C), arrhythmias, QT prolongation, hyperglycemia (insulin resistance), infection, 'cold diuresis' → hypovolemia.
arabicExplanation: مضاعفات TTM: اعتلال تخثر (يبدأ عند 35°C)، اضطرابات نظم، إطالة QT، فرط سكر، عدوى، 'إدرار بارد' → نقص حجم.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 35-year-old man with hypotension and tachycardia after MVC. Unknown blood type. Which blood type is the best choice?
