englishExplanation: Men can receive O+ blood (save O- for women of childbearing age). O negative for females of childbearing age (prevent Rh alloimmunization). Type O has no A/B antigens.
arabicExplanation: الذكور يمكنهم استلام O+ (احفظ O- للنساء في سن الإنجاب). O سالب للإناث في سن الإنجاب لمنع التحسس Rh.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A man requires a pRBC transfusion for a GI bleed. History of 'bad' reactions to multiple transfusions (fever). What is the best choice to decrease the likelihood of a similar reaction?
englishExplanation: Febrile nonhemolytic reactions from antileukocyte antibodies - use leukocyte-reduced. IgA-free for IgA deficiency; irradiated for immunocompromised (GVHD prevention).
arabicExplanation: تفاعلات حموية غير انحلالية من الأجسام المضادة للكريات البيضاء - استخدم leukocyte-reduced. IgA-free لنقص IgA؛ irradiated للمناعة المنخفضة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 9-year-old after MVC. BP 80/40 improves to 90/40 after 60 mL/kg crystalloid. What is the best approach to fluid management?
englishExplanation: Pediatric trauma after 60 mL/kg crystalloid → start PRBCs (10 mL/kg). Massive transfusion: >40 mL/kg adolescent. Early blood products for decompensated shock.
arabicExplanation: رضح أطفال بعد 60 mL/kg بلورات → ابدأ PRBCs (10 mL/kg). نقل مبكر للصدمة اللا معاوضة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which line represents systolic blood pressure on an arterial line waveform tracing?
englishExplanation: Systolic BP = peak of waveform. Dicrotic notch = aortic valve closure. Diastolic = minimum. Pulse pressure = difference. Wide pulse pressure: anemia, AR, sepsis.
arabicExplanation: الضغط الانقباضي = ذروة الموجة. الثلمة الثنائية (dicrotic notch) = إغلاق الصمام الأبهري. الانبساطي = الحد الأدنى.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What does the Allen test evaluate?
englishExplanation: Allen test: evaluate collateral hand circulation before radial artery access. 97.1% specific for poor collateral circulation. Normal palmar color return within 6 seconds.
arabicExplanation: اختبار ألين: تقييم الدورة الدموية الجانبية لليد قبل الوصول للشريان الكعبري. 97.1% نوعية.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What are the appropriate landmark descriptions for placement of a Resuscitative Endovascular Balloon Occlusion of the Aorta (REBOA) for refractory hemorrhagic shock from traumatic pelvic fracture?

options.text: Between manubrium and mid sternum (50-55 cm)
Between xiphoid to mid sternum (~46-50 cm)

englishExplanation: Zone III (renal artery to aortic bifurcation): ~26-28 cm just cephalad to umbilicus, 15 mm aortic diameter, 3 mL balloon. For pelvic/femoral hemorrhage. Zone I (46-50 cm) for infradiaphragmatic injuries.
arabicExplanation: المنطقة III (من الشريان الكلوي إلى تشعب الأبهر): ~26-28 cm فوق السرة، 3 mL في البالون. للنزف الحوضي/الفخذي.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which patient with traumatic hemorrhagic shock is most likely to benefit from REBOA?

options.text: Cardiac arrest 15 minutes before hospital arrival
Intra-abdominal injury, trauma surgeon available in 20 minutes
Pelvic fracture, interventional radiology available in 20 minutes
Penetrating chest trauma with suspected aortic injury

correctAnswer: Pelvic fracture, interventional radiology available in 20 minutes
englishExplanation: REBOA zone III for pelvic fracture - IR embolization target. Contraindications: traumatic cardiac arrest >10 min, intrathoracic vascular injury, cardiac tamponade, proximal aortic dissection.
arabicExplanation: REBOA منطقة III لكسر الحوض - هدف تصميم IR. موانع: توقف قلبي رضحي >10 دقائق، إصابة وعائية داخل الصدر، اندساس تاموري.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is a contraindication to placement of a REBOA?

options.text: No trauma surgeon available to place REBOA
Witnessed cardiac arrest in trauma bay

englishExplanation: Contraindications: intrathoracic vascular injury (distal occlusion worsens bleeding), traumatic cardiac arrest >10 min, cardiac tamponade, proximal aortic dissection.
arabicExplanation: موانع: إصابة وعائية داخل الصدر (الانسداد البعيد يفاقم النزف)، توقف قلبي رضحي >10 دقائق.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the most common complication of REBOA placement?
englishExplanation: Local vascular injury (~5.6%) most common: pseudoaneurysm, dissection, venous access. Embolism (4.3%). Limb ischemia (2.1%). Aortic rupture rare but deadly.
arabicExplanation: إصابة وعائية موضعية (~5.6%) الأكثر شيوعًا: أم دم كاذبة، تسلخ، وصول وريدي. انصمام (4.3%). نقص تروية الطرف (2.1%).

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: During REBOA, which vessel should be cannulated?
englishExplanation: Cannulate common femoral artery (proximal to profunda femoris takeoff). Use POCUS to avoid venous access. Sheath placement via Seldinger technique.
arabicExplanation: قسطرة الشريان الفخذي المشترك (فوق منشأ الشريان الفخذي العميق). استخدم POCUS لتجنب الوصول الوريدي.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: When attempting transvenous pacing, what is the preferred site for access?
englishExplanation: Preferred for transvenous pacing: right internal jugular or left subclavian (most direct route). Left subclavian preferred site for cardiology permanent pacer. Prosthetic tricuspid valve = absolute contraindication.
arabicExplanation: المفضل لتنظيم القلب عبر الوريد: الوداجي الداخلي الأيمن أو تحت الترقوة الأيسر (المسار الأكثر مباشرة). الصمام ثلاثي الشرف الصناعي = مانع مطلق.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: In which condition can intraosseous line placement be performed most safely?

options.text: Fracture in the distal aspect of the same bone

englishExplanation: IO contraindications: fracture of same bone, previous IO in same bone, osteogenesis imperfecta, osteopetrosis, overlying cellulitis. Poorly controlled diabetes not a contraindication.
arabicExplanation: موانع IO: كسر في نفس العظم، IO سابق في نفس العظم، تلين العظام، كثافة العظام، التهاب نسيج خلوي فوق الموقع. السكري غير المضبوط ليس مانعًا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the preferred site for intraosseous line placement in a 2-year-old child?
englishExplanation: Preferred IO site in children <6: proximal tibia (1-3 cm distal to tibial tuberosity). Distal femur as alternative. Adults: proximal tibia, proximal humerus, sternum.
arabicExplanation: موقع IO المفضل في الأطفال <6: الظنبوب القريب (1-3 cm تحت الحدبة). الفخذ البعيد بديل.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the most appropriate next step after defibrillation during the management of cardiac arrest?

options.text: Bedside ultrasound to evaluate cardiac activity

englishExplanation: After defibrillation: resume chest compressions for 2 minutes before next pulse/rhythm check. Pulse checks should be <10 seconds. Amiodarone only for refractory VF/VT.
arabicExplanation: بعد إزالة الرجفان: استأنف الضغطات لمدة دقيقتين قبل فحص النبض/النظم. فحوصات النبض <10 ثوانٍ.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 24-year-old man with stab wound to left chest, loses vital signs, needs bedside thoracotomy. Which structure must be avoided when incising the pericardium?
englishExplanation: Phrenic nerve runs along pericardium - cut anterior (closer to sternum) to avoid it. Injury → diaphragmatic weakness. Other structures: vagus behind right hilum, sympathetic chain lateral to vertebral bodies.
arabicExplanation: العصب الحجابي (phrenic nerve) يمتد على التامور - اقطع أماميًا (قرب القص) لتجنبه. إصابته → ضعف الحجاب.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: In which scenario is ECMO contraindicated?
englishExplanation: ECMO contraindications: intracranial hemorrhage, uncontrolled bleeding, terminal malignancy, irreversible end-organ damage, severe aortic regurgitation (VA-ECMO). Pregnancy is NOT a contraindication.
arabicExplanation: موانع ECMO: نزف داخل القحف، نزف غير مضبوط، أورام نهائية، فشل أعضاء لا رجعة فيه، قلس أبهر شديد. الحمل ليس مانعًا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: In which scenario is ECMO most likely indicated?

options.text: Cardiac arrest in a patient with severe aortic valve insufficiency
Hypoxic respiratory failure (PaO2/FiO2 <100) with severe peripheral vascular disease
Respiratory acidosis (pH <7.2) with end-stage liver disease
Right ventricular failure in a patient with a massive pulmonary embolism

correctAnswer: Right ventricular failure in a patient with a massive pulmonary embolism
englishExplanation: ECMO indications: reversible cardiac/respiratory failure refractory to standard treatment - PE, hypoxic respiratory failure (P:F <100), cardiac arrest, hypercapnic respiratory failure (pH <7.2).
arabicExplanation: استطبابات ECMO: فشل قلبي/تنفسي قابل للعكس لا يستجيب للعلاج - PE، فشل تنفسي نقص أكسجة (P:F <100)، توقف قلبي، فشل تنفسي فرط كابنيا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: In the setting of venoarterial extracorporeal CPR (ECPR), what procedures are commonly performed to initiate ECMO?

options.text: Cannulation of carotid artery and internal jugular vein
Cannulation of femoral artery and vein
Cannulation of femoral vein and subclavian vein
Cannulation of right and left femoral vein

correctAnswer: Cannulation of femoral artery and vein
englishExplanation: ECPR: VA-ECMO via femoral artery (15-17 Fr) + femoral vein (19-25 Fr). Ipsilateral or contralateral. Ultrasound guidance minimizes vascular injury.
arabicExplanation: ECPR: VA-ECMO عبر الشريان الفخذي (15-17 Fr) + الوريد الفخذي (19-25 Fr). نفس الجانب أو معاكس.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the most likely complication of ECMO?
englishExplanation: Bleeding + thromboembolism = most common major ECMO complications. Bleeding up to 50% (anticoagulation, platelet dysfunction, hemolysis). Monitor ACTs.
arabicExplanation: النزف والانصمام = أكثر مضاعفات ECMO الرئيسية شيوعًا. النزف حتى 50% (مضادات تخثر، خلل صفيحات، انحلال دم).

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: In which scenario is pediatric ECMO most likely indicated?

options.text: PaO2/FiO2 ratio less than 80 in a patient with ARDS
Pulmonary embolism in a patient with a grade IV glioblastoma
Respiratory acidosis (pH <7.1) in a patient with trisomy 18
Traumatic cardiac arrest in a patient with multiple gunshot wounds

correctAnswer: PaO2/FiO2 ratio less than 80 in a patient with ARDS
englishExplanation: Pediatric ECMO for ARDS with P:F <60-80. Contraindications: terminal malignancy, lethal genetic conditions (trisomy 18), irreversible organ damage, high bleeding risk.
arabicExplanation: ECMO للأطفال في ARDS مع P:F <60-80. موانع: أورام نهائية، حالات وراثية قاتلة (تثلث 18)، فشل أعضاء لا رجعة فيه.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 30-year-old found in a snowbank, awake but confused. ECG shows Osborn waves. What is the best rewarming technique?
englishExplanation: Stage II hypothermia (28-32°C): Osborn waves, bradycardia. Active external rewarming = forced warmed air (+3.4°C/hr). Avoids afterdrop. Bladder/gastric lavage = limited (small surface area).
arabicExplanation: المرحلة II من انخفاض الحرارة (28-32°C): موجات Osborn، بطء قلب. الإحماء الخارجي النشط = هواء دافئ مدفوع (+3.4°C/ساعة).

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 20-year-old found in snowbank in cardiac arrest. CPR ongoing. T 28°C. Despite resuscitation, K 12. What are the next best steps?

options.text: Continue CPR but increase epinephrine frequency
Hyperkalemia treatment and further rewarming techniques

englishExplanation: Hypothermia cardiac arrest: 'not dead until warm and dead' EXCEPT when K >10-12 (indicates irreversible damage). Other exceptions: lethal injuries, frozen body, avalanche with snow-packed airway >35 min.
arabicExplanation: توقف القلب من انخفاض الحرارة: 'ليس ميتًا حتى يدفأ ويموت' إلا إذا كان K >10-12 (ضرر لا رجعة فيه).

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A patient with large intraparenchymal hemorrhage is intubated. Postintubation, which parameters should be maintained?
englishExplanation: ICH: HOB 30° (venous return), PaCO2 35-40 (avoid hypercarbia), SBP 140 (AHA: lower if 150-220 to 140; if >220, lower <220 then to 140-160). Avoid neck constriction.
arabicExplanation: ICH: رفع الرأس 30°، PaCO2 35-40، SBP 140. تجنب انقباض الرقبة. خفض الضغط تدريجيًا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 25-year-old man with palmar laceration proximal to the MCP joint of the small finger. What is the best technique for anesthesia?
englishExplanation: Ulnar nerve innervates small finger, ulnar half of ring finger, and ulnar aspect of hand. Block between flexor carpi ulnaris and ulnar artery (~5 mL).
arabicExplanation: العصب الزندي (ulnar nerve) يعصب الخنصر، نصف البنصر الزندي، والجانب الزندي لليد. الحقن بين القابضة الزندية والشريان الزندي.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which technique helps reduce the pain of local infiltration with lidocaine?

options.text: Buffer with 1:1 ratio of sodium bicarbonate

englishExplanation: Reduce infiltration pain: inject through wound margins (not intact skin), 27-gauge needle, subcutaneous (not intradermal), slow injection, warm solution, buffer 1:10 with bicarb.
arabicExplanation: تقليل ألم الحقن: الحقن عبر حواف الجرح، إبرة 27، تحت الجلد (ليس داخل الأدمة)، بطء الحقن، محلول دافئ، تخفيف 1:10 مع البيكربونات.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 74-year-old woman with anterior shoulder dislocation, BP 86/40, P 110. IV access, fluid bolus minimal improvement. No allergies. Which medication for procedural sedation?
englishExplanation: Ketamine (sympathomimetic) preferred for hypotensive patients - causes hypertension. Propofol/midazolam cause hypotension. Fentanyl provides analgesia without sedation.
arabicExplanation: الكيتامين مفضل للمرضى المصابين بهبوط ضغط - يسبب ارتفاع ضغط. البروبوفول والميدازولام يسببان هبوطًا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which level of procedural sedation is characterized by reduced consciousness with purposeful response to commands, adequate spontaneous ventilation, and maintained cardiovascular function?
englishExplanation: Moderate sedation (conscious sedation): purposeful response to verbal/tactile stimulation, patent airway maintained, spontaneous ventilation adequate, CV function intact. Dissociative sedation (ketamine) is a subtype.
arabicExplanation: التهدئة المعتدلة (moderate sedation): استجابة هادفة للمنبهات اللفظية/اللمسية، مجرى هوائي سالك، تهوية تلقائية كافية، وظيفة قلبية وعائية سليمة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A patient with multiple myeloma and chronic kidney disease presents with severe pain from bone lesions. Which medication is most appropriate?
englishExplanation: Renal dysfunction: hydromorphone/fentanyl have minimal renally cleared active metabolites. Avoid morphine/codeine/tramadol/meperidine. Methadone too slow for acute pain.
arabicExplanation: قصور كلوي: هيدرومورفون/فنتانيل لها مستقلبات نشطة قليلة تُطرح كلويًا. تجنب المورفين/الكوديين. الميثادون بطيء للألم الحاد.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A patient receiving a lidocaine infusion for renal colic experiences paresthesias, perioral numbness, seizure, and cardiovascular collapse. What is the highest priority?
englishExplanation: Local anesthetic systemic toxicity (LAST): lipid emulsion 20% 1.5 mL/kg bolus + 0.25 mL/kg/min infusion. Modified ACLS (epi <1 mcg/kg, avoid vasopressin, avoid Na channel blockers).
arabicExplanation: سمية المخدر الموضعي الجهازية (LAST): مستحلب دهون 20% جرعة 1.5 mL/kg ثم تسريب 0.25 mL/kg/min. ACLS معدّل.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is first-line therapy for trigeminal neuralgia?
englishExplanation: Trigeminal neuralgia: paroxysmal sharp/stabbing unilateral pain (V2/V3). First-line: carbamazepine 100-200 mg/day. Alternatives: oxcarbazepine, lamotrigine, gabapentin, baclofen.
arabicExplanation: ألم العصب الثلاثي التوائم: ألم نوبي حاد وحيد الجانب (V2/V3). الخط الأول: carbamazepine. بدائل: oxcarbazepine, lamotrigine, gabapentin, baclofen.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What describes 'deep sedation'?

options.text: Not arousable to painful stimulation; airway and breathing impaired
Purposeful response to painful stimulation; airway and breathing may be impaired
Purposeful response to verbal or physical stimulation; airway and breathing maintained
Slowed response to verbal stimulation; airway and breathing unaffected

correctAnswer: Purposeful response to painful stimulation; airway and breathing may be impaired
englishExplanation: Deep sedation: purposeful response to REPEATED/PAINFUL stimulation. Airway/breathing may be impaired. Used for burn care, fracture reductions.
arabicExplanation: التهدئة العميقة: استجابة هادفة للمنبهات المؤلمة المتكررة. قد يعاني المجرى الهوائي والتنفس. تُستخدم لعلاج الحروق وردّ الكسور.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is a contraindication to receiving propofol?
englishExplanation: Only true immunologic contraindication to propofol: propofol allergy. Egg/soy/peanut allergies are NOT contraindications (proteins removed during manufacturing). AAAAI supports safety.
arabicExplanation: الموانع المناعية الحقيقية الوحيدة للبروبوفول: حساسية البروبوفول. حساسية البيض/الصويا/الفول السوداني ليست موانع.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: An otherwise healthy patient is intubated and experiences acute-onset rigidity. T 39.2°C. Which medication is likely responsible?
englishExplanation: Malignant hyperthermia from succinylcholine: diffuse rigidity, hyperthermia, tachycardia, tachypnea. Ryanodine receptor mutation. Treatment: dantrolene. Nondepolarizing agents (vecuronium) don't cause MH.
arabicExplanation: فرط الحرارة الخبيث من سكسينيل كولين: صلابة منتشرة، حمى، تسرع قلب، تسرع تنفس. طفرة مستقبلات الريانودين. العلاج: دانترولين.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the most consistent finding of succinylcholine-induced malignant hyperthermia?
englishExplanation: MH: hypermetabolic state → excessive CO2 production. Rising ETCO2 despite adequate ventilation is most consistent. Masseter rigidity transient (only 25% have persistent).
arabicExplanation: MH: حالة فرط استقلاب → إنتاج CO2 زائد. ارتفاع ETCO2 رغم التهوية الكافية هو الأكثر ثباتًا. صلابة العضلة الماضغة عابرة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What electrolyte disorder is most strongly associated with malignant hyperthermia?
englishExplanation: MH rhabdomyolysis → hyperkalemia, hyperphosphatemia, hypocalcemia. Hyperkalemia is most common and clinically significant. Treat with calcium + sequestration.
arabicExplanation: انحلال الربيدات في MH → فرط بوتاسيوم، فرط فوسفات، نقص كالسيوم. فرط البوتاسيوم هو الأكثر شيوعًا وأهمية سريريًا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the most appropriate empiric treatment for malignant hyperthermia?
englishExplanation: Dantrolene is a ryanodine receptor antagonist - skeletal muscle relaxant preventing Ca release. Definitive treatment for MH. Dose: 2.5 mg/kg.
arabicExplanation: دانترولين مضاد لمستقبلات الريانودين - مرخٍ عضلي هيكلي يمنع إطلاق الكالسيوم. العلاج النهائي لـ MH. الجرعة: 2.5 mg/kg.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which medication is contraindicated in patients with malignant hyperthermia who are treated with the appropriate reversal agent?
englishExplanation: Dantrolene + nondihydropyridine CCBs (diltiazem, verapamil) = life-threatening hyperkalemia + myocardial depression. Contraindicated. Dihydropyridines (amlodipine) safe.
arabicExplanation: دانترولين + حاصرات قنوات Ca غير ثنائية الهيدروبيريدين (diltiazem, verapamil) = فرط بوتاسيوم مهدد للحياة + تثبيط عضلي قلبي. ممنوعة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What should be used to help prepare a patient for an anoscopy?
englishExplanation: Anoscopy: simple bedside procedure, no sedation or bowel prep. Topical 2% lidocaine jelly 10 min before. Evaluates hemorrhoids, masses, fistulas, fissures, ulcers.
arabicExplanation: تنظير الشرج: إجراء بسيط بجانب السرير، لا تهدئة ولا تحضير معوي. جل ليدوكايين 2% موضعي قبل 10 دقائق.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which incision should be used to excise an acute thrombosed external hemorrhoid?
englishExplanation: Thrombosed external hemorrhoid (within 48-72h): elliptical incision directed radially from anal orifice. Allows clot removal without sutures. Linear incisions cause rethrombosis.
arabicExplanation: البواسير الخارجية المتخثرة (خلال 48-72 ساعة): شق بيضوي (elliptical) متجه شعاعيًا من فتحة الشرج. يسمح بإزالة الخثرة دون خياطة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 78-year-old woman with a clogged, nonfunctioning gastrostomy feeding tube. What technique to remove the clog should be tried first?
englishExplanation: Clogged G-tube: first flush with warm water using 60 cc syringe (better than cola/juice). Then commercial decloggers with pancreatic enzymes. Mechanical decloggers last. Replace tube if all fail.
arabicExplanation: انسداد أنبوب المعدة: أولًا اغسل بماء دافئ بمحقنة 60 cc. ثم مزيلات الانسداد التجارية بالإنزيمات البنكرياسية. إذا فشل كل شيء، استبدل الأنبوب.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: In which situation is placement of a nasogastric tube most indicated?

options.text: Abdominal distention in a patient with a small bowel obstruction
Gross hematemesis in a patient with history of gastric bypass

correctAnswer: Abdominal distention in a patient with a small bowel obstruction
englishExplanation: NG tube indications: ileus/SBO treatment, medications/contrast, enteral nutrition. No longer routine for hematemesis/massive rectal bleed. Contraindicated: coagulopathy, gastric bypass, midface injury.
arabicExplanation: استطبابات الأنبوب الأنفي المعدي: علاج علوص/انسداد الأمعاء، الأدوية/الصبغة، التغذية. لم تعد روتينية للنزف الهضمي. موانع: اعتلال تخثر، تحويل معدي، رضح الوجه.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 45-year-old man with massive hematemesis at a rural hospital without GI availability. Intubated, Sengstaken-Blakemore tube placed with initial hemostasis. What is the next step?

options.text: Transfer to hospital with GI availability

correctAnswer: Transfer to hospital with GI availability
englishExplanation: Sengstaken-Blakemore tube = temporary measure for variceal bleeding. Requires emergent GI for endoscopy. Transfer if GI unavailable. Don't deflate balloon without definitive treatment available.
arabicExplanation: أنبوب Sengstaken-Blakemore = إجراء مؤقت لنزف الدوالي. يتطلب تنظير هضمي عاجل. حوّل إذا لم يكن متوفرًا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which condition is the best indication for placement of an esophageal balloon tamponade device?
englishExplanation: Balloon tamponade for bleeding esophagogastric varices (up to 90% control). Contraindicated for gastric ulcer. Relative contraindications: esophageal stricture, recent bariatric surgery, hiatal hernia.
arabicExplanation: تطويق بالوني لدوالي المريء والمعدة (تحكم حتى 90%). ممنوع في قرحة المعدة. موانع نسبية: تضيق مريئي، جراحة سمنة حديثة، فتق حجابي.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: When obtaining informed consent for a tube thoracostomy, what possible complication should be discussed with the patient?

options.text: Injury to thoracic or abdominal structures

correctAnswer: Injury to thoracic or abdominal structures
englishExplanation: Tube thoracostomy complications: injury to thoracic/abdominal structures (incorrect placement), bleeding, hemothorax, chylothorax, air leak. Insert in 'triangle of safety' at 4th-5th ICS midaxillary line.
arabicExplanation: مضاعفات بضع الصدر الأنبوبي: إصابة بنى صدرية/بطنية، نزف، استرواح دموي، تسرب هواء. الإدخال في 'مثلث الأمان' عند الفراغ 4-5 بين الأضلاع.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A patient with spontaneous pneumothorax, SpO2 92%, increased work of breathing. What is the best step in definitive management?

options.text: Hospitalize and give albuterol and steroids
Insert a 20 Fr chest tube in the 4th ICS at midaxillary line
Insert a 32 Fr chest tube in the 5th ICS at anterior axillary line

correctAnswer: Insert a 20 Fr chest tube in the 4th ICS at midaxillary line
englishExplanation: Indications for intervention: abnormal vitals, tension, >20% volume, hemothorax, SpO2 <90%, RR >24. 20 Fr adequate for pneumothorax. Large-bore (>24 Fr) if hemothorax.
arabicExplanation: استطبابات التدخل: علامات حيوية غير طبيعية، ضاغط، >20% حجم، استرواح دموي، SpO2 <90%، RR >24. 20 Fr كافٍ للاسترواح الهوائي.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 72-year-old woman with syncope. Alert, normal vitals. ECG shows paced rhythm with intermittent capture. What management is appropriate?

options.text: Amiodarone 150 mg over 10 min then 1 mg/min
Aspirin 325 mg and activate cath lab
Midazolam 4 mg IV and begin transcutaneous pacing
Order chest x-ray and BMP, arrange pacemaker interrogation

correctAnswer: Order chest x-ray and BMP, arrange pacemaker interrogation
englishExplanation: Pacemaker malfunction (intermittent capture): stable patient → workup with ECG, BMP, CXR (lead fracture). Interrogate pacemaker. If unstable → transcutaneous pacing.
arabicExplanation: خلل الناظم (التقاط متقطع): مريض مستقر → ECG، BMP، CXR (كسر السلك). استجواب الناظم. إذا غير مستقر → تنظيم عبر الجلد.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What effect will placing a magnet over a patient's pacemaker have on pacemaker function?

options.text: Double the rate of the pacemaker
Inhibit the pacemaker from delivering a shock
Set the pacemaker at a fixed rate

correctAnswer: Set the pacemaker at a fixed rate
englishExplanation: Magnet over pacemaker: asynchronous fixed-rate pacing (usually 60 bpm). Magnet over AICD: inhibits shocks but keeps pacing.
arabicExplanation: المغناطيس فوق الناظم: تنظيم غير متزامن بمعدل ثابت (عادة 60 نبضة/دقيقة). فوق AICD: يمنع الصدمات لكن يبقي التنظيم.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: An 87-year-old woman with syncope, BP 87/42, P 27. Complete AV block with wide QRS. Atropine ineffective. What is the most appropriate next intervention?
englishExplanation: Third-degree AV block with wide QRS (below AV node) - atropine ineffective. Second-line: transcutaneous pacing, dopamine, or epinephrine. Pace pads on all atropine-refractory bradycardia.
arabicExplanation: حصار AV ثلاثي الدرجة مع QRS واسع (تحت العقدة) - الأتروبين غير فعال. الخط الثاني: تنظيم عبر الجلد، دوبامين، إبينفرين.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is an indication for overdrive pacing?

options.text: Atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response

englishExplanation: Overdrive pacing for refractory torsades de pointes (magnesium-resistant). Increases heart rate → shortens QT. Goal HR 90-110. Transvenous preferred.
arabicExplanation: التنظيم المتسارع (overdrive pacing) لـ torsades de pointes المقاوم للمغنيزيوم. زيادة معدل القلب → تقصير QT. الهدف 90-110.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the proper interpretation of 'VOO' mode for transvenous pacing?

options.text: Atrial/ventricular pacing, atrial/ventricular sensing, triggered and inhibited
Atrial/ventricular pacing, no sensing, no response
Ventricular pacing, no sensing, no response

correctAnswer: Ventricular pacing, no sensing, no response
englishExplanation: NBG code: 1st letter = chamber paced, 2nd = chamber sensed, 3rd = response. VOO = ventricular only, no sensing, no response (asynchronous). DOO is also common. VVI = ventricular sensed, inhibited.
arabicExplanation: رمز NBG: الحرف 1 = الحجرة المنظَّمة، 2 = الحجرة المحسوسة، 3 = الاستجابة. VOO = بطيني، بدون تحسس، بدون استجابة (غير متزامن).

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the appropriate final resting location for a transvenous pacing wire?
englishExplanation: Transvenous pacer wire → right ventricle. Confirm with electromechanical capture. CXR after placement. Complications: bleeding, infection, pneumothorax, dislodgement.
arabicExplanation: سلك الناظم عبر الوريد → البطين الأيمن. تأكيد بالالتقاط الكهربائي الميكانيكي. CXR بعد الإدخال.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the preferred access site for placement of a transvenous pacemaker?
englishExplanation: Preferred: right internal jugular (most direct). Second: left subclavian (reserved for cardiology permanent pacer). Femoral requires long threading, higher infection.
arabicExplanation: المفضل: الوداجي الداخلي الأيمن (الأكثر مباشرة). الثاني: تحت الترقوة الأيسر (محجوز للناظم الدائم). الفخذي يتطلب تمرير طويل وعدوى أعلى.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: An 80-year-old woman with syncope, BP 90/48, P 30. Complete AV block with narrow QRS. Atropine improves HR. What is the next step if vitals worsen?
englishExplanation: Atropine-sensitive bradyarrhythmia (narrow QRS, AV nodal) → redose atropine up to 3 mg every 3-5 min. If fails → pacing/dopamine/epinephrine.
arabicExplanation: بطء قلب حساس للأتروبين (QRS ضيق، عقدي AV) → أعد جرعة الأتروبين حتى 3 mg كل 3-5 دقائق. إذا فشل → تنظيم/دوبامين/إبينفرين.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: In which scenario is cardioversion most indicated?

options.text: 23-year-old with palpitations 4 days and AF with RVR
57-year-old with chest pain and third-degree AV block
63-year-old with chest pain and diaphoresis with wide-complex tachycardia
75-year-old with CHF/COPD and acute SOB with multifocal atrial tachycardia

correctAnswer: 63-year-old with chest pain and diaphoresis with wide-complex tachycardia
englishExplanation: Unstable tachyarrhythmia → cardioversion. Wide-complex tachycardia = VT. MAT does not respond to cardioversion. Bradyarrhythmias → pacing.
arabicExplanation: تسرع نظمي غير مستقر → تقويم كهربائي. تسرع معقد واسع = VT. MAT لا يستجيب للتقويم. بطء القلب → تنظيم.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 55-year-old man with syncope, on apixaban, diaphoretic, altered mental status. BP 75/38, P 152, SpO2 92%. ECG shows atrial fibrillation. What is the best next step?
englishExplanation: Unstable atrial fibrillation with RVR (hypotension, altered mental status) → synchronized cardioversion. Patient on anticoagulant (minimizes thrombus risk). Monophasic 200J, biphasic 120-200J.
arabicExplanation: رجفان أذيني غير مستقر مع RVR (هبوط ضغط، تغير وعي) → تقويم كهربائي متزامن. المريض على مضاد تخثر.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 60-year-old man with sudden-onset chest pain radiating to back, pale, diaphoretic. ECG finding that indicates additional posterior leads should be obtained?

options.text: Hyperacute T waves in precordial leads
ST-segment depression in leads V1 and V2
ST-segment depression in leads V5 and V6

correctAnswer: ST-segment depression in leads V1 and V2
englishExplanation: Posterior MI: ST depression in V1-V2, tall R in V1-V2. Order posterior leads (V7-V9). ST elevation ≥0.5 mV in any posterior lead = acute MI.
arabicExplanation: احتشاء خلفي: انخفاض ST في V1-V2 وموجة R طويلة. اطلب الخيوط الخلفية (V7-V9). ارتفاع ST ≥0.5 mV = احتشاء حاد.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 60-year-old man with pressure-like chest pain. ECG: ST elevation in I, aVL with ST depressions in III, aVF, V1-V3. What is the diagnosis?
englishExplanation: Lateral STEMI: ST elevation in I, aVL (high lateral) with reciprocal changes in III, aVF, V1-V3. Left circumflex or first diagonal (D1) branch of LAD. If V1-V4 also involved → proximal/mid LAD.
arabicExplanation: احتشاء جانبي: ارتفاع ST في I, aVL مع تغيرات متبادلة. الشريان المنعطف الأيسر أو الفرع القطري الأول.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 25-year-old asymptomatic man with ECG showing J-point elevation, concave ST segments, no reciprocal changes. What is the diagnosis?
englishExplanation: BER: J-point elevation, concave ST, no reciprocal changes, no T-wave inversions. Most prevalent in precordial and inferior leads. Common in young healthy patients.
arabicExplanation: إعادة الاستقطاب المبكرة الحميدة (BER): ارتفاع نقطة J، ST مقعر، لا تغيرات متبادلة، لا انقلاب T. شائعة في الشباب الأصحاء.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 60-year-old with chest pain. ECG shows widened QRS >120 ms, broad notched R in I, aVL, V5-V6, large S in V1. What is the diagnosis?
englishExplanation: LBBB: QRS >120 ms, broad notched R in I/aVL/V5-V6, discordant T inversions, large S in V1. Use modified Sgarbossa criteria for STEMI.
arabicExplanation: حصار الفرع الأيسر (LBBB): QRS >120 ms، موجة R عريضة مُسننة في I/aVL/V5-V6، انقلاب T متنافر، موجة S كبيرة في V1. استخدم معايير Sgarbossa المعدلة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which ECG finding would suggest left ventricular hypertrophy?

options.text: R wave amplitude in V5 of 30 mm

correctAnswer: R wave amplitude in V5 of 30 mm
englishExplanation: LVH criteria: R in V5 or V6 + S in V1 or V2 >35 mm; R in V5 >26 mm; R in V6 >18 mm; largest R + largest S >45 mm. Can mimic ischemia (ST depression/T inversion in V4-V6).
arabicExplanation: معايير LVH: R في V5 أو V6 + S في V1 أو V2 >35 mm؛ R في V5 >26 mm؛ R في V6 >18 mm.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 70-year-old man with sudden severe headache, slow to respond, BP 220/90, P 58. ECG shows deep precordial T waves. What is the most likely diagnosis?
englishExplanation: Cerebral T waves (deep precordial T inversions) + Cushing reflex (hypertension + bradycardia) = ICH, especially SAH. Mimic ACS on ECG.
arabicExplanation: موجات T دماغية (انقلاب T عميق في الخيوط الصدرية) + منعكس Cushing (ارتفاع ضغط + بطء قلب) = نزف داخل القحف، خاصة SAH.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 75-year-old woman with CKD presents with lightheadedness, vomiting. ECG shows peaked T waves and shortened QT. What is the next best treatment?

options.text: No treatment until laboratory studies result

englishExplanation: Hyperkalemia with ECG changes → IV calcium immediately (membrane stabilization). Do not wait for labs. Then insulin/dextrose, albuterol, dialysis if needed.
arabicExplanation: فرط البوتاسيوم مع تغيرات ECG → كالسيوم وريدي فورًا (تثبيت الغشاء). لا تنتظر التحاليل.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 56-year-old with lightheadedness, nausea, vomiting. ECG shows QRS widening, ST changes, P-wave flattening. What electrolyte abnormality?
englishExplanation: Hyperkalemia progression: peaked T → shortened QT → QRS widening → P flattening → sine wave → cardiac arrest. Findings not stepwise - patient can have severe hyperkalemia with normal ECG.
arabicExplanation: تطور فرط البوتاسيوم: T مدببة → QT قصير → QRS واسع → P مسطحة → موجة جيبية → توقف قلبي.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A man with ESRD and pacemaker for sick sinus syndrome presents with syncope, missed 3 dialysis sessions. ECG shows pacemaker spikes with sine wave between. What is definitive management?
englishExplanation: Severe hyperkalemia in ESRD: IV calcium (membrane stabilization) + emergent dialysis. Insulin/dextrose only temporizing. Start dialysis process immediately.
arabicExplanation: فرط بوتاسيوم شديد في ESRD: كالسيوم وريدي + غسيل كلى طارئ. الإنسولين/دكستروز مؤقت فقط.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 70-year-old with SOB, pain radiating to neck and back. ECG shows ST elevation >2 mm in V1-V4. What is the most likely cause?
englishExplanation: Anterior/anteroseptal STEMI: ST elevation V1-V4 = LAD ('widowmaker'). Most commonly affected coronary artery in STEMI. High morbidity/mortality if not promptly treated.
arabicExplanation: احتشاء أمامي/أمامي حاجزي: ارتفاع ST في V1-V4 = LAD ('صانع الأرامل'). الأكثر إصابة في STEMI.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 55-year-old with chest pain. During ECG analysis, what finding would be consistent with evolving STEMI?

options.text: ST elevation <1 mm in all leads

englishExplanation: Evolving STEMI: hyperacute T waves (earliest) → ST elevation → Q waves → T inversions. De Winter T waves (hyperacute T + ST depression in precordial leads) = STEMI equivalent.
arabicExplanation: STEMI المتطور: موجات T فرط الحدة (الأبكر) → ارتفاع ST → موجات Q → انقلاب T. موجات De Winter = مكافئ STEMI.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: ST elevation would be expected in which ECG leads in an inferior STEMI?
englishExplanation: Inferior STEMI: ST elevation II, III, aVF. 80% right coronary artery (RCA). Risk of RV infarction - avoid nitroglycerin (preload reduction worsens RV failure).
arabicExplanation: احتشاء سفلي: ارتفاع ST في II, III, aVF. 80% الشريان التاجي الأيمن (RCA). خطر احتشاء RV - تجنب النيتروغليسرين.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A patient with lightheadedness, BP 90/60, P 40. ECG shows regular narrow QRS with no P waves. What is the best interpretation?
englishExplanation: Junctional bradycardia: HR 40-60, narrow QRS, regular, no P waves. SA node dysfunction → AV node/bundle of His pacemaker. Treatment: transcutaneous/transvenous pacing.
arabicExplanation: بطء قلب عقدي (junctional bradycardia): معدل 40-60، QRS ضيق، منتظم، لا موجات P. خلل العقدة الجيبية.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the best interpretation of this ECG (progressive PR prolongation until dropped beat)?

options.text: Second-degree heart block Mobitz type I
Second-degree heart block Mobitz type II

correctAnswer: Second-degree heart block Mobitz type I
englishExplanation: Wenckebach: progressive PR prolongation → dropped beat (P without QRS). Usually benign, can be normal in athletes. Symptomatic → atropine.
arabicExplanation: فينكيباخ (Wenckebach): تطويل PR تدريجي → نبضة ساقطة. عادة حميد، طبيعي عند الرياضيين. أعراض → أتروبين.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 70-year-old with dizziness. ECG shows constant PR interval with intermittent dropped beats. What is definitive management?
englishExplanation: Mobitz type II: constant PR, intermittent dropped beats. Structural damage to AV conduction system. Higher risk of progression to third-degree block. Pacemaker required.
arabicExplanation: Mobitz type II: PR ثابت، نبضات ساقطة متقطعة. ضرر بنيوي لنظام التوصيل AV. خطر تطور لحصار كامل. يتطلب ناظمًا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 20-year-old athlete with cough, normal vitals. ECG shows progressive PR prolongation with dropped beat. What is the appropriate management?
englishExplanation: Mobitz type I (Wenckebach) in asymptomatic athlete = normal (high vagal tone). No treatment. If symptomatic → atropine, rarely pacemaker.
arabicExplanation: Mobitz type I (Wenckebach) في رياضي بدون أعراض = طبيعي (نغمة مبهمية عالية). لا علاج.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: An 80-year-old man with P 37. ECG shows P waves regular at faster rate than QRS complexes, complete dissociation. What is the interpretation?

options.text: Second-degree heart block Mobitz type I
Second-degree heart block Mobitz type II

englishExplanation: Complete AV dissociation: P waves regular at faster rate; QRS regular at slower rate (ventricular escape). Treatment: emergent pacing if unstable; permanent pacemaker definitively.
arabicExplanation: انفصال AV كامل: موجات P منتظمة بمعدل أسرع؛ QRS منتظم بمعدل أبطأ (هروب بطيني). العلاج: تنظيم عاجل + ناظم دائم.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 60-year-old with lung cancer and SOB, BP 75/60, P 130, JVD, muffled heart sounds, clear lungs. Which finding on bedside echo would you expect?
englishExplanation: Cardiac tamponade (Beck triad: hypotension + JVD + muffled heart sounds). Echo: RA compression, RV diastolic collapse, dilated IVC without inspiratory collapse. Emergency pericardiocentesis.
arabicExplanation: اندساس قلبي (Beck triad): هبوط ضغط + JVD + أصوات قلب مكتومة. الإيكو: ضغط الأذين الأيمن، انخبار البطين الأيمن الانبساطي. بزل تامور عاجل.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 65-year-old with dyspnea, asthma, stage IV ovarian cancer. Decreased breath sounds on right, dullness to percussion. Bedside US shows pleural effusion. What is the appropriate treatment?
englishExplanation: Pleural effusion: decreased breath sounds + dullness + hypoechoic area above diaphragm on US. Thoracentesis for dyspnea relief, infection, or unclear etiology.
arabicExplanation: انصباب جنبي: أصوات تنفسية منخفضة + بلادة + منطقة ناقصة الصدى فوق الحجاب. بزل الصدر لتخفيف الضيق أو العدوى أو سبب غير واضح.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is a contraindication to ultrasound-guided thoracentesis?
englishExplanation: Thoracentesis contraindications: skin infection at site, insufficient fluid, severe bleeding diathesis. Creatinine >6 = relative. US guides loculated effusions. Lateral to 9th ICS risk of organ injury.
arabicExplanation: موانع بزل الصدر: عدوى جلدية بالموقع، سائل غير كافٍ، اعتلال تخثر شديد. الإيكو يوجه الانصبابات المحدقة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A patient with hemopneumothorax after penetrating trauma. Chest tube placed but persistent air leak despite proper connections. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: Persistent pneumothorax due to re-expansion pulmonary edema
Puncture of the esophagus from chest tube insertion
Underlying injury to the lung parenchyma

correctAnswer: Underlying injury to the lung parenchyma
englishExplanation: Persistent air leak in trauma = parenchymal lung injury (alveolar-pleural fistula). Most leaks resolve spontaneously. Persistent → surgical management.
arabicExplanation: تسرب هواء مستمر في الرضح = إصابة نسيج الرئة (ناسور سنخي جنبي). معظم التسربات تُشفى تلقائيًا. المستمر → جراحة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 19-year-old from burning building, GCS 7, intubated. Full-thickness burns over 80% of body (excluding face and hands). Becomes increasingly difficult to ventilate with equal breath sounds, normal CXR. What is the best next step?

options.text: Ask to switch the ventilator to pressure control
Perform needle decompression of the chest
Remove the endotracheal tube and reintubate

englishExplanation: Circumferential chest burns → constriction → impaired ventilation. Escharotomy through eschar (and possibly fascia) decompresses. Also indicated for circumferential extremity/neck burns with vascular compromise.
arabicExplanation: حروق صدرية دائرية → انقباض → ضعف تهوية. بضع القشرة (escharotomy) يفك الضغط. أيضًا للأطراف/الرقبة مع ضعف وعائي.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the most appropriate technique for incision and drainage of a felon?

options.text: Incise across the distal interphalangeal crease
Make a longitudinal incision over the area of fluctuance

correctAnswer: Make a longitudinal incision over the area of fluctuance
englishExplanation: Felon: longitudinal incision over area of greatest fluctuance (ideally lateral, avoid center fat pad). Do NOT cross DIP crease (flexor tendon injury). Fishmouth only by hand specialist.
arabicExplanation: داحس الإصبع (felon): شق طولي فوق منطقة التموج (جانبيًا، تجنب منتصف الوسادة الدهنية). لا تتجاوز ثنية DIP.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 25-year-old with left index finger pain after striking with a hammer. Tenderness of distal phalanx and large area of darkening below intact nail. What is the best next step?

options.text: Discharge with analgesics and oral antibiotics
Perform trephination of the nail plate
Remove the nail and repair the nail bed
Request an emergent consultation with a hand surgeon

correctAnswer: Perform trephination of the nail plate
englishExplanation: Subungual hematoma >50% of nail plate: trephination with cautery or 18-gauge needle. Immediate pain relief. Does not increase bone infection risk. Nail removal only if nail avulsion or nail fold disruption.
arabicExplanation: ورم دموي تحت الظفر >50%: بضع الظفر (trephination) بكي كهربائي أو إبرة 18. راحة فورية للألم. لا يزيد خطر عدوى العظم.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which closure technique provides the greatest tensile strength in a wound located over a joint?
englishExplanation: Sutures: greatest tensile strength, lowest dehiscence rate, most accurate approximation. Adhesive tape: lowest tensile strength. Staples: quick, less accurate. Tissue adhesive: lowest infection rate.
arabicExplanation: الخياطة (sutures): أعلى قوة شد، أقل انفتاح للجرح، أدق تقريب للحواف. الشريط اللاصق: الأقل قوة. الدبابيس: سريعة. اللاصق النسيجي: أقل عدوى.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 32-year-old woman after stepping on a rusted nail. Last tetanus 6 years ago; all childhood vaccines. After dressing and antibiotics, what is the next step?

options.text: Administer tetanus immunoglobulin and tetanus toxoid
No other treatment steps are indicated

englishExplanation: Puncture wound + last tetanus >5 years: give tetanus toxoid. Immunoglobulin only if incomplete vaccination or unknown history. Tdap preferred <65 years.
arabicExplanation: جرح ثاقب + آخر كزاز >5 سنوات: أعطِ توكسويد الكزاز. الغلوبولين المناعي فقط إذا كان التطعيم ناقصًا أو مجهولًا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 65-year-old man with nosebleed, on warfarin (INR 4). What is the most appropriate initial step?

options.text: Administer fresh frozen plasma and vitamin K
Apply compression to the anterior nares

correctAnswer: Apply compression to the anterior nares
englishExplanation: Anterior epistaxis: pinch nares 10-15 min + oxymetazoline. Most from Kiesselbach plexus. Blood products as adjuncts. Do not treat hypertension acutely (anxiety). Cautery only if vessel visualized.
arabicExplanation: رعاف أمامي: اضغط على المنخرين 10-15 دقيقة + أوكسيميتازولين. معظمه من ضفيرة Kiesselbach. لا تعالج الضغط حادًا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the most appropriate initial treatment for epistaxis in a pediatric patient?

options.text: Apply silver nitrite cautery to the bleeding site
Apply topical phenylephrine to the nares

englishExplanation: Pediatric epistaxis (2-10 years, digital trauma, URI): first pinch nares over Kiesselbach plexus 5-10 min. Then topical phenylephrine, cautery, packing. Consider bleeding disorder, nasal angiofibroma (adolescent male, severe unilateral).
arabicExplanation: رعاف الأطفال (2-10 سنوات، رضح إصبعي): اضغط أولًا 5-10 دقائق. ثم فينيل إفرين، كي، حشو.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the source of most epistaxis episodes?
englishExplanation: 90% of epistaxis = anterior, from Kiesselbach plexus (anastomosis of superior labial, anterior ethmoidal, sphenopalatine). Posterior from sphenopalatine artery.
arabicExplanation: 90% من الرعاف = أمامي من ضفيرة Kiesselbach (تفرع الشفة العلوي، الغربالي الأمامي، الوتدي الحنكي).

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the most common cause of epistaxis in adults?
englishExplanation: Most common epistaxis cause: URI/rhinosinusitis. Other common: digital trauma, chemical irritants, deviated septum, dryness, chronic nasal cannula. Hypertension is NOT a cause (anxiety-related).
arabicExplanation: السبب الأكثر شيوعًا للرعاف: التهاب الجهاز التنفسي العلوي. ارتفاع الضغط ليس سببًا (ناتج عن القلق).

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which patient is most likely to require admission for epistaxis?

options.text: Diabetic with anterior epistaxis and nasal packing
Diabetic with posterior epistaxis and posterior packing
Warfarin patient with anterior epistaxis and packing
Sleep apnea patient with posterior epistaxis and posterior packing

correctAnswer: Sleep apnea patient with posterior epistaxis and posterior packing
englishExplanation: Admission for epistaxis: cardiac/respiratory illness requiring CPAP or NC oxygen + nasal packing, or posterior epistaxis with posterior packing. Posterior more severe.
arabicExplanation: إدخال الرعاف: مرض قلبي/تنفسي يحتاج CPAP أو O2 أنفي + حشو، أو رعاف خلفي مع حشو خلفي.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: When draining a peritonsillar abscess, what is the first structure that might be injured if the typical approach goes too far posteriorly?
englishExplanation: PTA drainage: carotid artery lies posterior and lateral to tonsil. Needle should not go >1 cm deep. Children: shorter distance → ENT involvement.
arabicExplanation: تصريف خراج حول اللوزة: الشريان السباتي خلفي ووحشي للوزة. لا تتجاوز الإبرة 1 cm عمقًا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the optimal airway technique for use in patients with cervical spine injuries?
englishExplanation: Hyperangulated VL follows oropharynx curve - less cervical spine movement needed. Traditional-geometry requires sniffing position. Fiberoptic also good but equipment/operator limited.
arabicExplanation: تنظير الفيديو شديد التقوس (hyperangulated) يتبع منحنى البلعوم - حركة أقل للعمود الرقبي.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: In preparation for intubating a 1-year-old child via direct laryngoscopy, what strategy should be used?
englishExplanation: Children <3 years: floppy epiglottis - use straight (Miller) blade. Larger occiput → roll under shoulders not occiput. Cuffed tubes now standard.
arabicExplanation: أطفال <3 سنوات: سان المزمار رخو - استخدم نصلًا مستقيمًا (Miller). وسادة تحت الكتفين لا تحت القفا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 16-year-old with eye pain and worsening vision after being struck in the face. Eyeball protruding, bloody; IOP 45 mm Hg. Ophthalmologist unavailable for 1 hour. What is the best next step?
englishExplanation: Retrobulbar hemorrhage/orbital compartment syndrome - vision-threatening emergency. Lateral canthotomy if IOP >40 with ophthalmology unavailable. Do NOT massage (worsens open globe).
arabicExplanation: نزف خلف المقلة/متلازمة حيز الحجاج - طارئ بصري. بضع الصوار الجانبي (lateral canthotomy) إذا IOP >40 مع عدم توفر طبيب العيون.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 23-year-old with proptosis of the left eye after basketball injury. Decreased vision. What is the best treatment in the ED?

options.text: Apply gentle pressure to reduce the eye

englishExplanation: Orbital compartment syndrome: proptosis + vision loss + afferent pupillary defect + tight eyelids + increased IOP. Immediate lateral canthotomy. Do NOT apply pressure.
arabicExplanation: متلازمة حيز الحجاج: جحوظ + فقدان بصر + عيب حدقي وارد + جفون مشدودة + IOP مرتفع. بضع الصوار الجانبي فورًا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which finding on slit-lamp examination suggests traumatic iritis?

options.text: Blood collection visible beneath the conjunctiva
Blood layering in the anterior chamber
Green fluorescent stream overlying the cornea
Small floating flecks visible in the anterior chamber

correctAnswer: Small floating flecks visible in the anterior chamber
englishExplanation: Traumatic iritis: cells ('floating flecks') + flare in anterior chamber + consensual photophobia + ciliary flush. Treatment: cycloplegics (homatropine) + topical steroids. Follow-up 3-5 days.
arabicExplanation: التهاب القزحية الرضحي: خلايا ('نقاط عائمة') + ضباب في الغرفة الأمامية + رهاب ضوء تبادلي. العلاج: موسعات حدقة + ستيرويدات موضعية.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: An emergency resident is using the slit lamp to evaluate eye redness. Blue light with narrow beam is used. Which part should be adjusted to make the beam wider?
englishExplanation: Round dial at bottom (B) adjusts beam width. Wide beam + blue light + fluorescein = assess corneal abrasions/ulcers. Narrow beam + white light = anterior chamber.
arabicExplanation: القرص الدائري في الأسفل (B) يعدل عرض الحزمة. حزمة واسعة + ضوء أزرق + فلوريسين = تقييم خدش القرنية.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 65-year-old woman with headache, left eye pain, vision loss. Hazy cornea, mid-dilated unreactive pupil. Which test will confirm the diagnosis?
englishExplanation: Acute angle-closure glaucoma: painful red eye + hazy/steamy cornea + mid-dilated unreactive pupil + headache + nausea. IOP measured by tonometry (can be 60 mm Hg; normal 10-20).
arabicExplanation: الزرق الحاد مغلق الزاوية: عين حمراء مؤلمة + قرنية ضبابية + حدقة متوسطة غير متفاعلة + صداع + غثيان. قياس ضغط العين بالـ tonometry.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 32-year-old after getting a tooth knocked out 30 minutes ago. Brought intact tooth in milk. Small clot in socket. What is the best next course of action?

options.text: Clean the tooth with a brush

englishExplanation: Avulsed permanent tooth: reimplant within 60 min. First remove clot with gentle saline irrigation. Handle by crown, transport in milk/Hanks. Never reimplant primary teeth.
arabicExplanation: سن دائم مقتلع: إعادة زرع خلال 60 دقيقة. أولًا أزل الخثرة بغسل ملحي لطيف. أمسك بالتاج، انقل في الحليب. لا تعد زرع الأسنان اللبنية.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 24-year-old with red painful eye. Foreign body in the cornea. What is the best next step?

options.text: Attempt to remove with a moistened cotton applicator
Patch the eye closed and ophthalmology in 48 hours
Use a burr drill to remove the rust ring

correctAnswer: Attempt to remove with a moistened cotton applicator
englishExplanation: Corneal foreign body: after anesthesia + slit lamp assessment, remove with moistened cotton applicator (or 18-gauge needle bevel-up). Burr for rust ring - not in visual axis. Antibiotics after removal.
arabicExplanation: جسم غريب في القرنية: بعد التخدير والتقييم، أزله بمسحة قطنية مبللة أو إبرة 18. المثقب للصدأ فقط - ليس في محور الرؤية.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the minimum PPE required when performing a physical examination for a patient with suspected disseminated herpes zoster?

options.text: Gloves, gown, and N95 or higher-level respirator

correctAnswer: Gloves, gown, and N95 or higher-level respirator
englishExplanation: Disseminated herpes zoster = contact + airborne + droplet precautions → gloves + gown + N95. Localized zoster = contact. Measles, TB, COVID = airborne.
arabicExplanation: الهربس النطاقي المنتشر = احتياطات التلامس + الهواء + الرشاش → قفازات + ثوب + N95.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A physician's blood gets into eye. Patient denies HIV risk factors; rapid HIV antibody negative. What is the recommended course of postexposure prophylaxis?

options.text: No postexposure prophylaxis unless HIV PCR is positive

englishExplanation: Source patient rapid HIV negative + no recent high-risk exposures → no PEP needed. Risk from mucous membrane exposure 0.09%. If source HIV+ → 3-drug regimen (TDF/FTC + raltegravir or dolutegravir).
arabicExplanation: مصدر HIV سلبي سريع + لا تعرضات عالية الخطورة → لا حاجة للوقاية بعد التعرض. خطر التعرض المخاطي 0.09%.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the strongest contraindication to arthrocentesis?

options.text: Presence of a hereditary clotting factor disorder
Suspected cellulitis overlying the arthrocentesis site

correctAnswer: Suspected cellulitis overlying the arthrocentesis site
englishExplanation: Arthrocentesis contraindication: cellulitis overlying site (introduces bacteria into joint). Relative: coagulopathy, bleeding disorders, prosthetic joints. Lipohemarthrosis confirms occult fracture.
arabicExplanation: موانع بزل المفصل: التهاب نسيج خلوي فوق الموقع (يُدخل بكتيريا للمفصل). نسبية: اعتلال تخثر، مفاصل صناعية.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 28-year-old with closed tibia fracture, anterior compartment pain, tense. Which BP and compartment pressure would most likely warrant fasciotomy?
englishExplanation: Delta pressure = diastolic - compartment. Fasciotomy if delta ≤30 mm Hg. Option A: delta = 60-32 = 28 mm Hg → fasciotomy. Others: 64, 73, 73 mm Hg → no fasciotomy.
arabicExplanation: ضغط الفرق (delta) = الانبساطي - ضغط الحيز. بضع اللفافة إذا delta ≤30 mm Hg. الخيار A: delta = 28 → جراحة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which immobilization method is indicated for a nondisplaced scaphoid fracture?
englishExplanation: Nondisplaced scaphoid: short arm thumb spica (neutral wrist + thumb immobilization). Unstable (>1 mm displacement): long arm thumb spica + ortho. Missed scaphoid → AVN.
arabicExplanation: كسر زورقي غير منزاح: جبيرة قصيرة إبهامية (thumb spica). غير مستقر (>1 mm): جبيرة طويلة + جراحة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A patient with right arm held in fixed abducted overhead position after high-speed MVC. No fracture on x-ray. What is the correct diagnosis and management?

options.text: Inferior dislocation of glenohumeral joint requiring reduction

correctAnswer: Inferior dislocation of glenohumeral joint requiring reduction
englishExplanation: Inferior shoulder dislocation (luxatio erecta): arm held overhead. Reduction with upward/outward traction. Surgical if failed reduction, fracture, or open injury.
arabicExplanation: خلع كتف سفلي (luxatio erecta): الذراع مرفوعة فوق الرأس. الإرجاع بشد علوي/خارجي. جراحة إذا فشل الإرجاع أو كسر.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A plaster splint is being applied for a distal tibia fracture. How many layers of plaster should be used?
englishExplanation: Plaster splint: 8-12 layers (thin sheets need multiple for strength). Pad 2-3 layers cotton + extra over bony prominences. Immobilize joints proximal + distal to fracture.
arabicExplanation: جبيرة الجبس: 8-12 طبقة (صفائح رقيقة تحتاج عدة طبقات للقوة). حشوة قطن 2-3 طبقات + إضافية على النتوءات العظمية.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A patient is discharged with a newly placed volar splint for a metacarpal fracture. What should they be instructed to do first at home if they experience finger swelling, numbness, or tingling?

options.text: Call the hospital operator to page the on-call orthopedic surgeon
Proceed directly to the emergency department
Remove the elastic bandage and rewrap more loosely

correctAnswer: Remove the elastic bandage and rewrap more loosely
englishExplanation: Splint too tight: loosen elastic bandage + elevate + ice. If symptoms persist >20-30 min → ED (concern for compartment syndrome). Never ignore neurovascular symptoms.
arabicExplanation: الجبيرة ضيقة جدًا: أرخِ الرباط المطاطي + ارفع + ثلج. إذا استمرت الأعراض >20-30 دقيقة → الطوارئ (خوف من متلازمة الحيز).

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A patient after a fall onto an outstretched hand has scaphoid tenderness but negative wrist x-ray. How should this patient be managed?

options.text: Do not apply any splint or bandage
Wrap the wrist in an elastic bandage

englishExplanation: Occult scaphoid fracture: thumb spica splint + ortho follow-up with repeat x-rays in 1-2 weeks. Scaphoid has tenuous blood supply → AVN if missed.
arabicExplanation: كسر زورقي كامن: جبيرة إبهامية + متابعة عظمية مع إعادة تصوير 1-2 أسبوع. التغذية الدموية هشة → تنخر وعائي إن أُهمل.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A patient with hand pain. X-ray shows 5th metacarpal fracture (boxer's fracture). What type of splint should be placed?
englishExplanation: Boxer's fracture (5th metacarpal): ulnar gutter splint from distal fingers to mid forearm. MCP joints flexed 50-90°, wrist slight extension, PIP/DIP extension. Hand surgery follow-up.
arabicExplanation: كسر مشط اليد الخامس (boxer's fracture): جبيرة الحافة الزندية (ulnar gutter) من الأصابع البعيدة إلى منتصف الساعد.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A sugar tong splint is placed on a patient with an arm injury. What is the most likely fracture this patient sustained?
englishExplanation: Sugar tong splint: distal radius/ulna fractures (Colles, Smith), mid-shaft forearm. Extends from dorsal distal metacarpals around elbow (90°) to volar distal metacarpals. Prevents supination/pronation.
arabicExplanation: جبيرة sugar tong: كسور الكعبرة/الزند البعيدة (Colles, Smith)، كسور منتصف الساعد. تمنع الكب والبسط.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 30-year-old after falling on elbow, x-ray shows olecranon fracture. What is the most appropriate management?
englishExplanation: Olecranon fracture: long arm posterior splint (elbow 90°, wrist neutral/slight extension, extends to MCP). Urgent ortho (often requires surgery for intra-articular or displaced).
arabicExplanation: كسر الزنبوبة (olecranon): جبيرة خلفية طويلة للذراع (مرفق 90°). جراحة عاجلة غالبًا.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 45-year-old after fall with right ankle deformity. X-ray shows trimalleolar fracture with dislocation. After reduction, what is the most appropriate immobilization?
englishExplanation: Trimalleolar fracture with dislocation: reduce + posterior ankle splint + stirrup (sugar tong for ankle). Unstable - CAM boot insufficient. Bimalleolar fractures similarly splinted.
arabicExplanation: كسر ثلاثي الكواحل مع خلع: إرجاع + جبيرة خلفية + stirrup (sugar tong للكاحل). غير مستقر - CAM غير كافٍ.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A patient with wrist pain. X-ray shows nondisplaced capitate fracture. What type of splint should be placed?
englishExplanation: Nondisplaced carpal bone fracture: volar short arm splint (metacarpal heads to mid forearm, wrist slight extension). Assess median nerve + flexor tendons (capitate forms carpal tunnel).
arabicExplanation: كسر عظم رسغي غير منزاح: جبيرة راحية قصيرة (volar short arm). تقييم العصب المتوسط والأوتار القابضة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 30-year-old with elbow and forearm pain after bicycle crash. X-ray shows comminuted proximal ulna fracture and anteriorly dislocated radial head. What is proper management?

options.text: Emergent orthopedic consultation for surgical management
Long arm splinting with orthopedic follow-up
Radial head reduction with orthopedic follow-up
Sling for comfort with orthopedic follow-up

correctAnswer: Emergent orthopedic consultation for surgical management
englishExplanation: Monteggia fracture-dislocation: proximal ulna fracture + radial head dislocation. Requires ORIF (open reduction internal fixation). Galeazzi = distal radius + DRUJ dislocation.
arabicExplanation: كسر-خلع مونتجيا (Monteggia): كسر الزند القريب + خلع رأس الكعبرة. يتطلب تثبيتًا داخليًا جراحيًا (ORIF).

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A football player lying prone cannot move legs. What is the best way to immobilize and protect this player's spine?

options.text: Have the player roll themselves over onto a spine board
Keep prone while lifting onto spine board
Maintain prone and lift onto EMS stretcher
While maintaining C-spine control, logroll into supine position onto a spine board

correctAnswer: While maintaining C-spine control, logroll into supine position onto a spine board
englishExplanation: Prone athlete with suspected spinal cord injury: logroll supine onto spine board (opposite direction of face), maintain C-spine. Supine improves safety, airway access.
arabicExplanation: رياضي مستلقٍ على بطنه مع إصابة نخاعية محتملة: دحرجة (logroll) إلى وضع مستلقٍ على لوح العمود الفقري مع الحفاظ على العمود الرقبي.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What lumbar interspace level should be used when performing a lumbar puncture on an infant?
englishExplanation: Infant LP: L4-L5 or L5-S1 (spinal cord ends at L3 in infants). Adults/children: L2-L3 or below. Avoid neck hyperflexion in infants (airway compromise).
arabicExplanation: بزل قطني للرضع: L4-L5 أو L5-S1 (الحبل الشوكي ينتهي عند L3 عند الرضع). البالغون/الأطفال: L2-L3 أو أقل.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the correct maneuver to resolve shoulder dystocia during delivery?
englishExplanation: Shoulder dystocia: McRoberts first, then suprapubic pressure (NOT fundal). Avoid excessive downward traction (brachial plexus injury). Rubin/Woods rotational maneuvers, deliver posterior arm.
arabicExplanation: عسر ولادة الكتف: McRoberts أولًا، ثم ضغط فوق العانة (ليس ضغطًا رحميًا). تجنب الشد السفلي المفرط.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: During which of the cardinal movements of labor is it appropriate to check for a nuchal cord?

options.text: External rotation of the fetal head
Internal rotation of the fetal head

correctAnswer: External rotation of the fetal head
englishExplanation: After delivery of fetal head (external rotation): check for nuchal cord. Loose → slip over head. Tight → clamp x2, cut between, unwind. If cut → deliver immediately.
arabicExplanation: بعد ولادة الرأس (الدوران الخارجي): افحص الحبل السري الملتف حول الرقبة (nuchal cord). رخو → انزلق فوق الرأس. مشدود → اقطع ولف.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: How should the umbilical cord in a newborn be managed for most US hospital-based births?
englishExplanation: ACOG: dry cord care for US hospital births (keep dry, water only if soiled). Delayed clamping 30-60s (increases iron stores, decreases NEC/IVH in preterm). Double-clamp 3 cm from abdominal wall.
arabicExplanation: ACOG: رعاية جافة للحبل السري في المستشفيات الأمريكية. تأخير الربط 30-60 ثانية. الربط المزدوج 3 cm من جدار البطن.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the next best step in the management of an infant with omphalitis?
englishExplanation: Omphalitis: infection of umbilical stump, polymicrobial (S. aureus, S. pyogenes, gram-negatives). Requires IV antibiotics (antistaphylococcal penicillin + aminoglycoside). Can progress to sepsis/necrotizing fasciitis.
arabicExplanation: التهاب السرة (omphalitis): عدوى متعددة الجراثيم. يتطلب مضادات حيوية وريدية (بنسلين مضاد للمكورات + أمينوغليكوزيد).

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: An infant presents with omphalitis and history of recurrent infections. What is the most likely underlying condition?
englishExplanation: Leukocyte adhesion deficiency (autosomal recessive): delayed cord separation + omphalitis + recurrent infections. Inability to form pus, no leukocytosis. Treatment: antibiotics, HSCT for severe.
arabicExplanation: عوز التصاق الكريات البيضاء (LAD): تأخر انفصال الحبل السري + التهاب سرة + عدوى متكررة. عدم القدرة على تكوين القيح.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: An infant with fecal discharge from the umbilicus. What is the most likely diagnosis?
englishExplanation: Omphalomesenteric fistula: failure of OMD to obliterate → connection ileum to umbilicus → feculent discharge. Urgent surgical consult (risk of prolapse/incarceration).
arabicExplanation: ناسور معوي سري (omphalomesenteric fistula): عدم انغلاق القناة → اتصال اللفائفي بالسرة → إفراز برازي. استشارة جراحية عاجلة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which infant clinical presentation warrants urgent surgical consultation?

options.text: Induration of umbilical stump and abdomen
Small, red, moist, velvety umbilical mass

correctAnswer: Induration of umbilical stump and abdomen
englishExplanation: Omphalitis extending to abdominal wall → risk of necrotizing fasciitis → urgent surgical consult. Umbilical hernia reducible = no surgery. Granuloma = silver nitrate.
arabicExplanation: التهاب السرة الممتد لجدار البطن → خطر التهاب لفافة ناخر → استشارة جراحية عاجلة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 36-week pregnant woman in cardiac arrest. Fundal height near xiphoid. What type of abdominal incision for emergency cesarean delivery?
englishExplanation: Perimortem cesarean: vertical midline from 4-5 cm below xiphoid to 2-3 cm above pubic hair. Initiate within 4-5 min of maternal arrest. No need to scrub abdomen, no need to move to OR.
arabicExplanation: قيصرية بعد الوفاة (perimortem): شق خطي متوسط. ابدأ خلال 4-5 دقائق من توقف الأم. لا حاجة للنقل لغرفة العمليات.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: During the physical examination of a female sexual assault victim, what is the most likely injury?
englishExplanation: Sexual assault: most common genital injury = posterior fourchette (tense band of mucous membrane). Genital exam often normal despite assault. Colposcopy increases detection 6%→53%.
arabicExplanation: الاعتداء الجنسي: أكثر إصابة تناسلية شيوعًا = الفرجة الخلفية (posterior fourchette). الفحص غالبًا طبيعي.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: When obtaining a history from a reported sexual assault victim, on which element of the history should the emergency department avoid focus?

options.text: Details leading up to the assault

correctAnswer: Details leading up to the assault
englishExplanation: Sexual assault history: gather info for focused exam + forensics. Leave details leading up to assault to investigating authorities (avoid conflicting statements). Document alcohol/drugs, condom use, gynecologic history.
arabicExplanation: تاريخ الاعتداء الجنسي: اجمع معلومات للفحص والطب الشرعي. اترك تفاصيل ما قبل الاعتداء للسلطات.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: After a sexual assault examination is completed, how should the evidence be handled until it can be transferred to police?

options.text: Leave on the charge nurse desk
Store in the emergency department refrigerator

englishExplanation: Chain of custody: evidence kit must remain in kit collector's direct line of sight or locked securely until collected by law enforcement. Failure = inadmissible in court.
arabicExplanation: سلسلة الحيازة: صندوق الأدلة يجب أن يبقى في مرأى جامع الصندوق أو مقفلًا بإحكام حتى يستلمه القانون.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What testing should be routinely performed after sexual assault of a female patient?
englishExplanation: Female reproductive age: pregnancy test before STI prophylaxis (doxycycline replaced with azithromycin in pregnancy). STI testing deferred if prophylaxis accepted. Offer emergency contraception.
arabicExplanation: أنثى في سن الإنجاب: اختبار الحمل قبل الوقاية من STI (استبدل doxycycline بـ azithromycin في الحمل). عرض وسائل منع الحمل الطارئة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What is the most common complication of prolonged restraint use?
englishExplanation: Restraint complications: abrasions/bruising most common. Death from improper positioning (hog-tie, face-down). Also hyperthermia, rhabdomyolysis. Use soft nylon, de-escalation first, sedatives if needed.
arabicExplanation: مضاعفات القيود: الخدوش/الكدمات الأكثر شيوعًا. الوفاة من الوضع الخاطئ (hog-tie). أيضًا فرط حرارة، انحلال الربيدات.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Which finding most suggests delirium as a cause of agitation?
englishExplanation: Delirium: acute onset, waxing/waning, altered awareness/attention. Visual hallucinations (not auditory). Look for life-threatening causes: WHIMPS (Withdrawal, Hypoxia, Intracranial, Metabolic, Poisoning, Seizures).
arabicExplanation: الهذيان (delirium): بداية حادة، تذبذب، تغير الوعي/الانتباه. هلاوس بصرية (ليس سمعية). ابحث عن الأسباب المهددة: WHIMPS.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 6-year-old with autism spectrum disorder is brought in for violent behavior. Visibly upset, attempts to strike staff. What is the best next step?

options.text: Have caregiver attempt to soothe child
Speak loudly to gain child's attention

correctAnswer: Have caregiver attempt to soothe child
englishExplanation: Autism: sensory processing issues. Try non-invasive soothing first (caregiver best resource). Avoid restraints (intolerable). Benzodiazepines risk paradoxical reactions. Lower voice volume.
arabicExplanation: التوحد: مشاكل في المعالجة الحسية. جرب التهدئة غير الباضعة أولًا (مقدم الرعاية أفضل مصدر). تجنب القيود.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: Autistic children have an elevated risk of having what other concomitant disease?
englishExplanation: Autism comorbidities: epilepsy (11-30% vs 1.2% general), ADHD, GI dysfunction, dental issues, allergies. Also genetic syndromes: fragile X, Down, Angelman.
arabicExplanation: مرافقات التوحد: الصرع (11-30% مقابل 1.2% عام)، ADHD، خلل معوي، مشاكل أسنان، حساسية.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 9-month-old with epilepsy presents in status epilepticus. Multiple admissions for same. Neuroimaging normal. Undetectable antiepileptic medication. Which form of child abuse?
englishExplanation: Medical neglect: caregiver failure to provide medical care/treatment. Most common in children <1 year. Consider family resources/comprehension before assuming intentional harm.
arabicExplanation: الإهمال الطبي: فشل مقدم الرعاية في تقديم العلاج. الأكثر شيوعًا في الأطفال <1 سنة.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 6-month-old with 22q11.2 microdeletion (DiGeorge syndrome) presents with seizures. Afebrile. Which electrolyte abnormality should be evaluated?
englishExplanation: DiGeorge syndrome: parathyroid hypoplasia → hypocalcemia + hyperphosphatemia. Presents with seizures, tetany, jitteriness. Measure ionized calcium.
arabicExplanation: متلازمة ديجورج: نقص تنسج جارات الدرق → نقص كالسيوم + فرط فوسفات. يظهر باختلاجات وتشنج. قياس الكالسيوم المتأين.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: What consideration should be made when caring for an autistic child in the emergency department?

options.text: Assign room in center of ED

englishExplanation: Autism: minimize stimuli - dim lights, close door, isolate room (away from center), minimize staff. Engage caregivers, use child life specialists.
arabicExplanation: التوحد: قلل المحفزات - خفف الإضاءة، أغلق الباب، غرفة معزولة، قلل الطاقم. أشرك مقدمي الرعاية.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 68-year-old with lower abdominal pain and distended abdomen, unable to void for 6 hours. US shows enlarged bladder with 250 mL. 14 Fr Foley fails. What catheter next?
englishExplanation: Urethral obstruction (BPH): coudé catheter (semirigid curved tip) passes obstruction. Smaller catheter insufficient. Suprapubic if all else fails + urology unavailable.
arabicExplanation: انسداد الإحليل (BPH): قسطرة كوديه (coudé) - طرف منحني شبه صلب يتجاوز الانسداد. قسطرة أصغر غير كافية.

chapterTitle: Procedures and Skills Integral to the Practice of Emergency Medicine
question: A 75-year-old with BPH unable to urinate. Suprapubic catheter placed, 1.2 L output. What is the next best step?

options.text: Observe patient for at least 4 hours

correctAnswer: Observe patient for at least 4 hours
englishExplanation: Postobstructive diuresis risk with >800 mL output: observe 4 hours. If >200 mL/hr → admit for electrolytes + renal function. Otherwise discharge with urology follow-up.
arabicExplanation: خطر الإدرار بعد الانسداد مع إنتاج >800 mL: راقب 4 ساعات. إذا >200 mL/ساعة → إدخال. وإلا إخراج مع متابعة.
